6325d316.title: AIOPS Architect
6325d316.description:
**BIRLASOFT** 




 Job Description
 



**Pre\-Sales Solution Architect – AIOps, Observability \& Agentic AI** 




**Experience** 




 12–15 years
 



**Location** 




 Noida / Pune / Bengaluru / Hyderabad (Hybrid)
 



**Practice** 




 Service Integration Practice
 



**Employment Type** 




 Full\-time
 



 Role Summary
 



 As Pre\-Sales Solution Architect for AIOps, Observability, and Agentic AI, you will be the technical anchor for client pursuits across our IT Operations transformation portfolio. You will partner with sales, bid management, and delivery teams to translate client pain points into outcome\-driven solutions — architecting AIOps and observability landscapes, embedding Agentic AI into IT operations, and owning the technical solution from RFP response through to delivery handover. You will work OEM\-agnostically across Aisera and comparable enterprise AIOps platforms, positioning the right toolset and integration approach for each client environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Pursuit \& Solutioning** 



* Lead pre\-sales pursuits (RFPs, RFIs, proactive proposals) across AIOps, Service Assurance, Infra \& Application Monitoring, Event Management, and Automation/Orchestration — including multi\-tower and managed\-services deals.
* Architect end\-to\-end AIOps and observability solutions that ingest, normalize, and correlate high\-volume telemetry (metrics, logs, traces, events) across cloud, on\-prem, and hybrid estates to reduce client MTTD/MTTR.
* Design and embed Agentic AI solutions — autonomous/multi\-agent frameworks, LLM\-powered and function\-calling agents — into enterprise ITSM and IT/Cloud Operations workflows.
* Conduct technical discovery and value\-discovery workshops; convert client SLAs and reliability objectives into measurable SLIs/SLOs.
* Create solution designs, architecture blueprints, effort estimates, scope of work (SoW), and pricing inputs in partnership with sales, bid, finance, and delivery teams.
* Lead OEM/tool evaluations and POCs, balancing features, scale, cost, and integration complexity; leverage OEM partnerships (Aisera, ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk, etc.) for joint pursuits.
* Contribute to order\-booking and revenue targets for the pursuit pipeline; review pricing benchmarks and effort\-estimation models.



**Technical Authority \& Delivery Enablement** 



* Act as the technical SME and trusted advisor in client orals, solution defense, and stakeholder discussions; own objection handling and win\-theme alignment.
* Map client requirements into platform capabilities and a clear implementation roadmap.
* Define, build, and present compelling demos and Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) engagements; maintain reusable demo assets and reference architectures.
* Ensure a clean solution\-to\-delivery handover — transitioning architecture, scope, and assumptions to project/delivery teams for successful execution.
* Build the practice: develop reusable solution accelerators, estimation models, capability decks, and reference documentation; mentor solution and delivery engineers on AIOps patterns and Agentic AI adoption.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



**ITSM, ITOps \& Platforms (mandatory)** 



* 12–15 years in IT across design, engineering, implementation, and pre\-sales — with 3\+ years in pre\-sales/solutioning of AIOps use cases for enterprise/global clients.
* Strong understanding of IT operations, infrastructure management, and application performance monitoring; sound ITIL foundations.
* Hands\-on experience with ITSM tooling (ServiceNow preferred) and across enterprise AIOps platforms — Aisera, Moogsoft, BigPanda, ServiceNow ITOM/AIOps, HPE OpsRamp, ScienceLogic.
* Scripting (JavaScript or similar), low\-code/no\-code platforms, and hands\-on REST API integration and automation workflow experience.



**Observability, Cloud \& DevOps** 



* Expertise integrating and leveraging data from monitoring/logging/alerting tools — Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK (Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana), Splunk, Nagios, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, OpenTelemetry.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud — AWS, Azure, or GCP; working knowledge of containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
* DevOps \& SRE practices and tooling — Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, Helm, CI/CD pipelines.



**AI / ML / Agentic AI** 



* Understanding of ML for IT Operations — anomaly detection, predictive analytics, event correlation, and automated root\-cause analysis.
* Generative \& Agentic AI fluency: LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering, multi\-agent/agent\-orchestration, and LLM\-powered automation (AI workflows / function\-calling).
* Knowledge of RPA/Intelligent Automation (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) is a plus.



**Pre\-Sales \& Consulting Skills (high weightage)** 



* Proven RFP/proposal ownership, effort estimation, and pricing/benchmarking for large global deals in IT sourcing.
* Ability to drive client and multi\-stakeholder discussions, handle objections, and propose workaround solutions.
* Ability to scope pilots/PoVs, document scope/SoW, and drive them to successful completion.
* Outstanding presentation, storytelling, and consultative selling skills across all levels up to C\-suite; strong, collaborative team player comfortable in a high\-pressure pursuit environment.



 Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s in Engineering/Technology (mandatory); Master’s (M.S./M.Tech/MBA) preferred.
* ITIL knowledge mandatory, certification desirable; relevant cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and platform (ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Splunk) certifications advantageous.
* Willingness to travel for client pursuits.

cc4b34a3.title: Solution Architect
cc4b34a3.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators who are focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 


  


 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 


  


 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies that rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 


  


 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals and we have fun celebrating
 
 our wins.
 


  


 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and be your best self!
 



 At Anaplan these words come to life by making employees feel empowered and inspired.
   

 Building a strong culture around company values is an ongoing journey that will continue to be the core of our existence.
 


  


 We want you to think big and act bold through expressing your authentic best self! Anaplan is looking for a tenacious
 **SOLUTION ARCHITECT** 
  to join 
 **PROFESSIONAL SERVICES** 
 in
 **INDIA.** 
 This is a stellar opportunity to get involved in a highly visible, large scale SaaS cloud company. This role is an immediate full\-time position. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and seek unique problems that no one else is solving, keep reading. 
 


  


**Come see for yourself what an exciting place to work looks like**



  


**Insight on your impact** 



  


 We're not looking for average.  Do you enjoy diving into issues and designing complex solutions?  Do you have a passion for data, multi\-dimensional modeling and data integration? If so, this job is for you.
 


  


**What you'll be doing:** 



  


 As an Anaplan Solution architect, you are primarily responsible for architect, design and the successful delivery of Anaplan planning solutions in strategic accounts. You will:
 


  

  
* Understand, review and gather client requirements per Anaplan defined scoping \& analysis
  
* Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi\-dimensional models
  
* Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality
  
* Serve as the architectural SME for large\-scale connected planning solutions
  
* Exemplify The Anaplan Way
  
* Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager/Business Partner and team
  
* Develop Anaplan model documentation
  
* Participate and/or lead Data Integration and Migration Solutions
  
* Participate and/or lead UAT testing and deployment
  


  


**Your qualifications, your influence** 



  


*To be successful in the role, you must possess the following skills* 



  

  
* A 6 year degree in Finance, Accounting or Supply chain experience
  
* 4\+ years’ experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management solutions or 4\+ years experience in Data and Analytics
  
* 4\+ years experience in either of following functional areas : Financial Planning \& Analysis or Sales Performance Management
  
* Sophisticated Microsoft Excel / financial modeling skills
  
* Proven knowledge of a formal system implementation methodology – requirements gathering, design, build/test and deploy (Agile methodology preferable)
  
* Superb written and oral communication skills
  
* Proven track record to lead execute responsibilities simultaneously
  
* Appetite for service excellence and a collaborative style
  
* Strong understanding of data integration (inbound and outbound)
  
* Passion for business analytics, modeling and planning
  
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
  
* Results\-oriented, motivated, self\-starter
  
* Coaching mentality
  
* Collegial, open and grounded in integrity
  
* Desire to work with a truly dynamic and exciting team, with a “roll\-up your sleeves” approach
  
* Strong desire to excel and be committed to gaining exposure to multiple industries while further developing your career
  


  


  
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion** 

**and Belonging** 



  


 Build your career in a place that thrives on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 


  


 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
 


  


**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 



  


 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 


  


 Anaplan does not:
 


  

  
* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible, and then followed up via written communication.
  


  


 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

 \*Please note: this role is locally employed by and contracted directly through Logward India Private Limited.\*
 



  





  





**About the role** 




 As a
 **Solution Architect – Professional Service** 
 s, you will play a key role in delivering successful customer implementations by translating business requirements into scalable and efficient solutions within the Shippeo platform. This customer\-facing role combines business consulting, solution architecture, and technical configuration to help customers optimize their supply chain operations.
 



 Operating within a structure of "leadership without authority," you will excel at coordinating across five cross\-functional squads to ensure seamless project execution. You will serve as the primary technical contact for our customers, orchestrating value from the pre\-sales phase straight through to project handover.
 



  





  





**Please Not**

 To learn more about our culture and people, visit our Careers section or explore team stories on our social platforms.

8c01d1a0.title: Vice President - ServiceNow Architect
8c01d1a0.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview**
----------------


The ServiceNow Architect is a senior technical leader responsible for the strategic design, governance, and continuous evolution of the organization's ServiceNow platform. This role owns the end\-to\-end architectural vision for ServiceNow — spanning platform configuration, enterprise integrations, workflow automation, and the adoption of ServiceNow's AI and intelligence capabilities — ensuring the platform delivers measurable value across the business.


The ServiceNow Architect serves as the primary technical authority for the platform and works in close partnership with enterprise architecture, IT operations, business process owners, and product teams to transform ServiceNow from an ITSM tool into a strategic enterprise workflow automation hub. This individual operates at the intersection of technical depth and business strategy, shaping how work gets done across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**Platform Architecture \& Governance**
---------------------------------------

* Own the ServiceNow platform architecture, including instance strategy (production, sub\-production), domain separation considerations, upgrade planning, and long\-term roadmap
* Establish and enforce platform governance standards: development practices, scoped application design, naming conventions, update set management, and code review processes
* Define the ServiceNow data model strategy, including CMDB architecture, CI relationships, and data integrity governance in alignment with ITIL and business requirements
* Lead architecture reviews for all significant ServiceNow development efforts, providing design authority sign\-off and ensuring alignment with platform best practices
* Maintain architectural documentation including reference architectures, design decision records, and platform topology diagrams

**Enterprise Integration Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and own the integration architecture connecting ServiceNow to the broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including ERP, ITSM, HR systems, monitoring platforms, identity providers, and cloud services
* Architect integrations using ServiceNow's native capabilities — IntegrationHub, Flow Designer spokes, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Event Management — as well as third\-party iPaaS platforms where applicable
* Define integration patterns and standards for inbound/outbound data exchange, ensuring reliability, security, and maintainability at enterprise scale
* Lead integration efforts with key enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint), Azure, Active Directory/Entra ID, monitoring and observability tools, and HR platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors)
* Establish and govern the ServiceNow CMDB as the authoritative source of truth for enterprise configuration data, including discovery tooling, reconciliation rules, and CSDM alignment
* Partner with security and IAM teams to architect identity federation, SSO (SAML/OIDC), and role\-based access control across the platform

**Workflow Automation**
-----------------------

* Lead the architectural strategy for enterprise workflow automation on the ServiceNow platform, spanning IT, HR, Legal, Finance, Facilities, and other business domains.
* Design scalable, reusable automation frameworks using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, and Scripted REST APIs.
* Architect end\-to\-end process automation for key workflows including incident management, change management, employee onboarding/offboarding, procurement, and request fulfillment.
* Define standards for automation governance: approval workflows, SLA frameworks, notification architecture, and audit trail design.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across the enterprise by partnering with process owners and analyzing ticket and workflow data.
* Champion low\-code/no\-code automation patterns to enable business teams to build within governed guardrails, reducing reliance on centralized IT development

**ServiceNow AI \& Intelligence Capabilities:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Drive the adoption and architectural strategy for ServiceNow's AI and intelligence portfolio, including:


	+ **Now Assist (Generative AI):** Virtual agent augmentation, case summarization, resolution note generation, and AI\-assisted search across ITSM and non\-ITSM workflows.
	+ **Predictive Intelligence:** ML\-based classification, categorization, and routing of incidents, cases, and requests.
	+ **AI Search:** Unified enterprise search architecture leveraging ServiceNow's semantic search capabilities.
	+ **Process Optimization:** Identifying bottleneck and deviation patterns in workflows using ServiceNow's process mining capabilities.
	+ **Virtual Agent:** Conversational interface design and NLU topic architecture integrated with enterprise channels (Microsoft Teams, web portal).
* Assess organizational AI readiness, including data quality, CMDB health, and historical record hygiene as prerequisites for effective AI model performance
* Define governance and ethical use standards for AI\-driven automation and decision support within ServiceNow
* Stay current with ServiceNow's AI roadmap and evaluate new capabilities for applicability within the enterprise context

**Product \& Module Ownership**
-------------------------------

* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow product lines as adopted by the organization, which may include:


	+ IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), IT Asset Management (ITAM)
	+ HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Legal Service Delivery, Workplace Service Delivery
	+ Security Operations (SecOps), GRC / Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
	+ Customer Service Management (CSM), App Engine / Creator Workflows
* Evaluate new ServiceNow modules for strategic fit, total cost of ownership, and integration complexity before platform adoption decisions are made
* Manage the platform upgrade lifecycle, including scoped impact analysis, regression testing strategy, and stakeholder communication

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership on ServiceNow capabilities, investment priorities, and platform roadmap
* Partner with process owners and product managers to translate business requirements into scalable platform solutions
* Mentor ServiceNow developers, administrators, and business analysts — establishing technical standards and elevating team capability
* Represent ServiceNow architecture in enterprise architecture governance forums and technology review boards
* Manage the relationship with ServiceNow account teams, technical success managers, and implementation partners to maximize platform value

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 10\+ years of progressive IT experience, with at least 5 years in a senior architecture or technical lead role focused on ServiceNow
* Deep, hands\-on expertise across core ServiceNow platform capabilities:


	+ **Platform:** Instance architecture, Application Engine, Scoped Apps, CMDB, CSDM, Update Sets, ATF
	+ **Automation:** Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Business Rules, Scheduled Jobs, Event Management
	+ **Integration:** REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, LDAP/SSO, Azure/AWS connectors, iPaaS patterns
	+ **ITSM/ITOM/ITAM:** Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Discovery, Service Mapping, HAM/SAM
	+ **Portal \& UX:** Service Portal, Now Experience (UI Builder), Employee Center
* Demonstrated experience architecting ServiceNow integrations with complex, heterogeneous enterprise technology environments
* Proficiency in ServiceNow scripting: JavaScript (Glide API), REST API design, and client/server\-side scripting
* Strong working knowledge of ITIL processes and their implementation within ServiceNow
* Experience leading platform upgrades across major ServiceNow releases in production environments
* Excellent documentation skills with ability to produce architecture diagrams, integration maps, and design specifications

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

**Platform Mastery:** Expert command of ServiceNow architecture patterns, APIs, and the platform's evolving capability landscape

**Integration Thinking:** Designs loosely coupled, resilient integration architectures that scale across enterprise system boundaries

**Process Orientation:** Translates ambiguous business processes into structured, automatable workflows with appropriate governance

**AI Fluency:** Understands where AI and machine learning add genuine value and architects for responsible, effective adoption

**Strategic Influence:** Earns credibility with senior stakeholders and shapes platform investment decisions

**Mentorship:** Actively develops others and raises the overall technical capability of the ServiceNow practice

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow's AI portfolio, including Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, and AI Search
* ServiceNow certifications, including one or more of:


	+ Certified System Administrator (CSA)
	+ Certified Application Developer (CAD)

#### **Who We Are**



WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients' businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

### **What we want from you**


* Enterprise solution architecture across multiple products, teams, operational models, and business use cases.
* Ability to design scalable frameworks for platform reliability, health monitoring, operational insights, proactive issue detection, and executive visibility.
* Strong understanding of governance architecture, including access visibility, entitlement tracking, auditability, privacy, compliance, and operational accountability.
* Ability to identify gaps between business needs, operational needs, and current product capabilities, then define practical architecture patterns or prototypes to close those gaps.
* Cross\-platform Adobe Experience Cloud understanding across AEP, RTCDP, AJO, CJA, Analytics, Workfront, GenStudio, Experience League, and related integrations.
* Ability to translate complex platform signals into meaningful KPIs, value realization metrics, leadership reporting, and decision\-ready insights.
* Strong architecture judgment to decide what should be automated, standardized, monitored, governed, or escalated to product/engineering roadmap.
* Technical fluency with data, APIs, reporting, cloud platforms, and integration patterns, without the role being limited to hands\-on pipeline engineering.
* Strong technical leadership to influence cross\-functional teams, align stakeholders, guide implementation teams, and connect platform capabilities with measurable business outcomes.


### **What you'll be doing**



We are not looking for traditional AEP DA here. We are looking for solution lead who can guide team, unblock and help R\&I take to next level. Few points to consider...


* A traditional AEP Data Architect is primarily focused on core data architecture areas such as XDM design, datasets, identity strategy, ingestion patterns, data modeling, and activation readiness within AEP.
* The R\&I Solution Architect role is broader and more outcome\-driven.
* It focuses on making Adobe on Adobe reliable, governable, observable, automated, measurable, and scalable across teams and products.
* This includes designing solutions for platform health monitoring, data quality, access governance, operational insights, value realization, automation, and proactive issue detection.
* The key difference is that R\&I is not only designing how data flows through AEP. It is designing how the overall Adobe ecosystem operates successfully at enterprise scale.
* R\&I also helps close product gaps where out\-of\-the\-box capabilities may not fully meet Customer Zero needs, while partnering closely with engineering and product teams to influence future roadmap.


In short, the R\&I Solution Architect role combines solution architecture, operational excellence, governance, automation, observability, and business value measurement. It is a strategic architecture role that goes beyond traditional AEP data design and directly supports the success and scale.

  


### **What we can offer you**



Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we'll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We'll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.



Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.



We lead with **Heart**, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.  

We empower your **Brains** for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.  

And we champion **Courage**, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

#### **About WPP**



WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. fca02ec5.description:
Anblicks is seeking an AI Solution Architect to lead the evaluation, architecture, prototyping, and delivery enablement of AI\-powered business solutions. This is a hands\-on role for an architect who can move from an ambiguous business problem to a practical solution blueprint, validate feasibility through a proof of concept, and guide developers through implementation. The role spans generative AI, agentic systems, intelligent automation, predictive solutions, data integration, and responsible AI controls.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Use\-case discovery and prioritization: Facilitate business and technical discovery, assess whether AI is appropriate, define expected outcomes, and prioritize opportunities by value, feasibility, risk, and adoption readiness.
* Solution blueprinting: Translate business needs into platform\-neutral solution options covering generative AI, agentic workflows, RAG, automation, predictive models, or hybrid patterns.
* Detailed architecture: Create end\-to\-end designs for model interaction, orchestration, data and tool access, APIs, identity, observability, evaluation, security, and operational support.
* Proof of concept: Build or directly guide prototypes that validate technical feasibility, user value, quality, performance, and key risks before scaled implementation.
* Developer enablement: Provide design walkthroughs, reference patterns, technical decisions, code\-level guidance, and reviews throughout delivery rather than relying on document\-only handoffs.
* Platform and model assessment: Evaluate cloud AI services, foundational models, agent frameworks, integration patterns, and supporting data platforms against enterprise requirements.
* Responsible AI and governance: Embed privacy, security, auditability, human oversight, evaluation, content safety, and risk controls into architecture and delivery gates.
* Stakeholder communication: Present architecture decisions, trade\-offs, recommendations, and progress to engineering leaders, business stakeholders, risk partners, and executives.
* Reusable assets: Develop reference architectures, templates, guardrail patterns, evaluation scorecards, and playbooks that improve future delivery speed and consistency.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of technology delivery experience, including significant solution architecture or technical leadership responsibility.
* Proven experience designing and delivering production\-grade AI solutions such as LLM applications, RAG systems, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, or ML\-enabled products.
* Hands\-on software engineering capability in Python and/or a modern full\-stack technology, including APIs, cloud\-native services, integration, testing, and deployment practices.
* Ability to translate loosely defined business problems into measurable use cases, architecture decisions, implementation increments, risks, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with prompt and context design, model evaluation, grounding approaches, tool/API integration, observability, and secure deployment patterns.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, SQL, data quality, semantic concepts, and data\-access controls.
* Understanding of responsible AI, privacy, security, model risk, and governance practices for sensitive enterprise data.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to influence technical and executive audiences.
* Experience mentoring engineers and performing architecture and code reviews in iterative delivery environments.


**Preferred Qualitiffications**
* Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure data services, or comparable cloud AI platforms.
* Experience with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI\-compatible APIs, Model Context Protocol, vector search, knowledge graphs, agent frameworks, and enterprise RAG patterns.
* Full\-stack experience with modern web frameworks, API gateways, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and production observability.
* Experience in financial services, lending, collections, servicing, compliance, risk, dealer operations, or another highly regulated industry.
* Familiarity with PII/NPPI controls, model validation, audit evidence, and human\-in\-the\-loop approval patterns.

 At PrivaSapien, the Solution Architect for Banking \& Financial Services serves as the technical bridge between PrivaSapien’s privacy platform and the complex application landscape of banking clients. The role requires deep integration architecture expertise combined with an understanding of banking technology ecosystems — core banking systems, middleware, regulatory frameworks, and enterprise change management. * Review application assessment reports and determine integration approach per application — API, SDK, webhook, DB connector, or middleware\-mediated.
* Navigate banking\-specific integration patterns: core banking systems (Finacle, Flexcube, T24\), middleware (MQ Series, Oracle ESB), batch processing, and legacy interfaces.
* Design consent SDK integration for React/Next.js frontends, Django/Python backends, and CMS\-driven content pages.
* Design multi\-property consent architecture — unified consent across news sites, job portals, classifieds, automotive, health, education, and streaming platforms with different data collection patterns.
* Integrate consent signals with Google Consent Mode v2, Google Ad Manager, and programmatic advertising stack.
* Troubleshoot integration issues in CDN\-cached environments — consent banner rendering, cache invalidation on consent change, and geolocation\-based consent requirements.
* Configure and validate integration patterns across tools per client application.
* Design solutions for consent lifecycle management within banking workflows — branch, mobile, internet banking, and third\-party channels.
* Troubleshoot integration failures across network, authentication, data format, and configuration layers in highly regulated environments.
* Produce architecture documents, integration playbooks, and wave\-by\-wave rollout plans.
* Work daily with client app\-owners, DPO, and IT teams to unblock integration and manage dependencies.
* Navigate banking CAB (Change Advisory Board) processes and production change management for go\-live.
* Provide structured feedback to PrivaSapien Engineering via Deployment Learning Reports, Integration Feedback Reports, and Architecture Decision Records.
* Evaluate PrivaSapien platform releases for compatibility with active customer deployments and manage upgrade paths.


**Requirements:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 14–15 years of experience in software engineering / solution architecture, with at least 3–4 years working in or for banking / financial services technology.
* Hands\-on experience integrating with core banking systems (Finacle, Flexcube, T24, or BaNCS) — not as a developer, but as someone who has designed integrations against these platforms.
* Strong expertise in REST API design, consumption, and security (OAuth2, API keys, mutual TLS, SAML).
* Experience with banking middleware and ESB layers (MQ Series, Oracle ESB, or equivalent).
* Database connectivity expertise (JDBC/ODBC, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB) for Privacy X\-Ray connector configuration.
* Deep JavaScript expertise — not just awareness; must understand execution order, async loading, tag management, and how consent scripts interact with ad\-tech tags in the browser.

* REST API design, webhooks, and event\-driven architecture for consent signal propagation across microservices.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes and container architecture for understanding PrivaSapien deployment topology.
* Cloud services experience (AWS preferred: EKS, RDS, S3, API Gateway).
* Experience with multi\-property web architectures — shared login, cross\-domain consent, and federated data management.
* Excellent communication skills — ability to present to client DPO, CTO, and app\-owner audiences in language each understands.


**Good to Have:**
* Understanding of cookie mechanics: first\-party vs third\-party cookies, SameSite attributes, Secure flags, cookie consent propagation to third\-party scripts.

* CDN and caching understanding: CloudFront, Akamai, how cached pages interact with dynamic consent state.
* Understanding of banking regulatory landscape: RBI IT guidelines, PCI\-DSS, data localisation directives, and now DPDP Act 2023 is preferable.
* Working knowledge of DPDP Act 2023 and Rules — consent lifecycle, data principal rights, and how they translate to technical integration requirements, would be an added advantage.

 As part of its next phase of growth, i\-TEK is building globally scalable products and platforms capable of supporting enterprise customers across industries and geographies through SaaS, dedicated deployments, and hybrid architectures.

 The Solution Architect will serve as the technical deployment authority for i\-TEK's products and platforms. The role is responsible for defining and governing deployment architectures, infrastructure sizing, security considerations, and operational readiness for customer implementations. The Solution Architect will act as the bridge between Product Engineering, Delivery, Customer Technology Teams, Infrastructure Teams, Security Teams, and Partner Ecosystems. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise across enterprise application deployments, cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and high\-availability architectures. The individual will be the technical face of i\-TEK during customer engagements and must be capable of confidently engaging with customer CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Security Teams, and Infrastructure Teams.

* Design deployment models supporting:
* SaaS environments
* Customer\-managed environments
* Hybrid deployments
* Multi\-site deployments
* Ensure deployment architectures align with customer business and technical requirements.
* Develop deployment blueprints and reference architectures.

* Ensure enterprise\-grade operational readiness.



**Security Architecture**

* Validate infrastructure readiness prior to deployment.

* Drive best practices around cloud adoption and modernization.

* Present deployment recommendations to customer stakeholders.

* Build strong relationships with customer technology leadership teams.



**Technology Evolution** 



* Track emerging technology trends.
* Recommend deployment innovations and automation opportunities.
* Drive standardization and simplification of deployment models.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of deployment frameworks.

**Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Senior Consultant** 




**Location:** 
 Hitech City, Hyderabad (On\-site)
 



**Company:** 
 AppsTek Corp
 



**Job Summary** 




 AppsTek Corp is seeking an experienced
 **Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Senior Consultant** 
 with 8–12 years of hands\-on experience to join our growing Oracle Enterprise Applications practice.
 



 This role is designed for a senior Oracle HCM professional who can
 **understand customer HR challenges, lead consulting and discovery engagements, design practical Oracle HCM solutions, support pre\-sales activities, and guide implementation teams through successful delivery** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate will be comfortable engaging directly with HR business leaders, HRIT stakeholders and client executives to understand business challenges, challenge existing processes, recommend Oracle best practices and translate business requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion HCM solutions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Customer Consulting \& Problem Solving** 



* Engage directly with customers to understand HR strategy, workforce challenges, process gaps and transformation priorities.
* Conduct current\-state assessments and identify opportunities for process standardization, simplification and optimization.
* Translate HR business challenges into practical Oracle Fusion HCM solution options.
* Challenge requirements where appropriate and recommend Oracle standard capabilities and best practices.
* Define future\-state HR processes and solution approaches aligned with business objectives.
* Help customers evaluate solution alternatives based on business value, complexity and implementation considerations.



**Solutioning \& Pre\-Sales** 



* Partner with sales and account teams during prospect and customer engagements.
* Lead discovery sessions, solution workshops and requirements discussions.
* Develop solution concepts, scope assumptions, implementation approaches and roadmaps.
* Deliver compelling Oracle Fusion HCM demonstrations based on customer business scenarios.
* Support RFP/RFI responses, proposals, estimates and customer presentations.
* Communicate the business value and expected outcomes of proposed HCM solutions.



**Oracle Fusion HCM Solution Architecture** 



* Design and guide end\-to\-end Oracle Fusion HCM solutions.
* Perform enterprise structures, workforce structures and security\-related setups.
* Lead functional solution design and configuration across key HCM modules:
* **Core HR:** 
 Enterprise structures, workforce structures, person/employment management and position management.
* **Absence Management:** 
 Accrual plans, qualification plans, absence recording and compliance rules.
* **Payroll:** 
 Element entries, payroll definitions, salary basis, costing and statutory requirements.
* **Talent Management:** 
 Goal Management, Performance Management, Talent Review and Succession Planning.
* **Recruiting / ORC:** 
 Job requisitions, candidate selection, career sites and onboarding.



**Workshops \& Delivery Assurance** 



* Lead client discovery sessions, Conference Room Pilots (CRPs), solution workshops and UAT cycles.
* Review functional designs, configuration decisions and test scenarios.
* Prepare and review Functional Design Documents, configuration workbooks and user documentation.
* Guide implementation teams through complex functional issues.
* Support post\-go\-live stabilization, enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.



**Integrations, Reporting \& Data** 



* Provide functional guidance to technical teams on HCM integrations, reporting and data migration.
* Work with teams using HCM Data Loader (HDL), HCM Extracts and spreadsheets.
* Provide functional guidance on Fast Formulas, OTBI and BI Publisher reporting.
* Work with integration teams on Oracle and external system integrations.



**Practice Development** 



* Contribute to building AppsTek's Oracle HCM consulting practice.
* Develop reusable solution patterns, templates, accelerators and assessment frameworks.
* Support creation of customer\-facing solution collateral and demonstrations.
* Mentor HCM consultants and contribute to delivery methodologies and best practices.
* Identify opportunities to expand Oracle HCM capabilities within existing and new customer accounts.



**Oracle Transformation \& AI Activation** 



* Stay aware of Oracle's evolving automation, analytics and AI capabilities relevant to HCM.
* Identify practical opportunities where automation or AI can improve selected HR processes and employee experiences.
* Support customer discussions around AI activation where there is a clear business use case.
* Collaborate with AppsTek's broader AI and technology teams when appropriate.



**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 8–12 years of experience in Oracle HCM.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM implementations.
* Core HR expertise is mandatory.
* Strong expertise across at least 2–3 additional modules such as Absence Management, Payroll, Talent Management or Oracle Recruiting Cloud.
* Proven experience in solution architecture, consulting and pre\-sales solutioning.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end HR processes such as Hire\-to\-Retire, workforce management, payroll, talent and recruiting.
* Proven ability to understand customer business problems and translate them into practical Oracle solutions.
* Experience conducting client workshops, demonstrations and solution presentations.
* Strong technical\-functional understanding of HDL, Fast Formulas, HCM Extracts and OTBI / BI Publisher.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working with global HR implementations and statutory/compliance requirements.
* Experience working with US or global enterprise customers is preferred.
* Oracle Fusion HCM certification is preferred.
* Exposure to Oracle automation, analytics or AI capabilities is an advantage.
* Industry experience in Manufacturing, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Financial Services, Energy \& Utilities or other complex enterprise environments is preferred.



**What Success Looks Like** 



* Customers see you as a trusted advisor, not simply an Oracle functional consultant.
* You understand the HR problem before designing the technology solution.
* You can independently lead discovery, solutioning and executive discussions.
* You contribute to winning Oracle HCM opportunities.
* You provide strong functional direction to delivery teams.
* You help build reusable AppsTek Oracle HCM consulting assets.
* You identify opportunities for process improvement, automation and selective AI activation.

**Requirements**

* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Personalization, Marketing Cloud Insights, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Data Cloud and Agent Force. Moderate experience with Sales, Service, Community, and Community Clouds

* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

c91f7ea7.title: VP - Cloud Center of Excellence
c91f7ea7.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**


LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence runs a lot of them across two continents. As VP, PMO, you'll lead the CCOE program\-management function and the India\-based team of project managers and scrum masters who keep delivery moving across the five CCOE teams. If you're a people\-first delivery leader who can turn a portfolio of overseas work into predictable outcomes, this is your seat.


As the VP, PMO, you lead the program\-management function for LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) and manage the team of project managers and scrum masters — primarily based in the India Global Capability Center (GCC) — who support the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery). **Bid Manager, Government IT**

Emdee Digitronics \| Kolkata \| Full Time, Permanent

Department: Bids \& Proposals

Experience: 4 to 7 years

Industry: IT Services \& Consulting (System Integration)

**About the Role**

Emdee is a 20\+ year old system integrator delivering IT infrastructure, software, security and surveillance, IT\-enabled services, and manpower solutions primarily to government and public sector clients. It is headquartered in Kolkata and has presence in multiple states.

The Bid Manager owns the bid function end to end: finding opportunities across government portals, screening them for fit and feasibility, and running participation through to submission. The role also owns the assets the function runs on, including the credential and document repository, the map of departments, nodal agencies and PSUs, competitor and partner intelligence, and win\-loss history. Alongside bidding, the role drafts technical and commercial documentation such as DPRs, BOQs, tenders, EOIs, and departmental correspondence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Discovery and Screening**

* Track tenders, EOIs, and empanelment opportunities across GeM, CPPP, state e\-procurement portals, and departmental sources
* Screen opportunities on eligibility, technical fit, evaluation mechanism, commercial viability, and competitive position, and present go/no\-go recommendations with a clear reading of terms, scope, and risk

**Bid Preparation and Submission**

* Own the bid calendar and run each submission to deadline, ensuring compliance with every published term, format, and annexure requirement
* Build and validate the commercial bid: work with procurement on rates, compute derived and formula\-driven line items, and account for taxes, maintenance and CAMC periods, escalation, and scope\-linked variables in the BOQ
* Compile technical and commercial submissions from inputs across technical, delivery, finance, and legal teams, including consortium and JV documentation, and draft the narrative and supporting content around them
* Arrange all participation prerequisites: EMD and tender fees, bank guarantees, DSC, portal and departmental registrations, statutory certificates, affidavits, undertakings, and power of attorney, sourcing from the repository or coordinating with stakeholders as required

**Stakeholder and Partner Coordination**

* Draft and collate pre\-bid queries, engage departments and nodal agencies through pre\-bid meetings and evaluation clarifications, and track corrigenda, amendments, and revised timelines through the bid cycle
* Coordinate with OEMs, partners, and consortium counterparts on MAF, back\-to\-back terms, pricing support, and eligibility mapping across parties
* Track evaluation progress, participate in reverse auctions and negotiations, and follow through on award documentation, PBG arrangement, and EMD refund recovery

**Documentation and Drafting**

* Draft DPRs, BOQs, tenders, EOIs, proposals, and formal correspondence to departments and institutional clients
* Use AI tooling for document parsing, analysis, synthesis, and generative drafting, verifying all output against source documents. The role must be able to produce the same standard of work without it

**Repository and Intelligence**

* Own the credential and document repository: work orders, performance certificates, financial and statutory documents, certifications, and reusable bid content, kept current and submission\-ready
* Maintain the institutional map of departments, nodal agencies, PSUs, and relationship managers, and track competitor and prospective partner activity to inform bid and consortium strategy
* Maintain the bid tracker and win\-loss history, and report pipeline, submission status, and outcomes to leadership

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Commerce, or Business Administration. MBA or PG Diploma in Business Management preferred
* 4 to 7 years in bid management, tendering, or proposals, with substantial experience bidding to central and state government departments, PSUs, and public institutions
* Hands\-on experience with GeM, CPPP, and state e\-procurement portals including the West Bengal e\-Procurement portal, covering bid submission, corrigendum tracking, and reverse auction participation
* Working knowledge of government procurement: GFR 2017, CVC guidelines, GeM primacy, evaluation mechanisms (L1, QCBS, LCS), and statutory preference regimes including MSE, Startup, and Make in India local content rules
* Demonstrated ownership of end\-to\-end submissions in an IT company or system integrator, covering technical and commercial bids, EMD and bank guarantees, and the full annexure and undertaking set
* Strong Excel proficiency. Must be able to build and audit a commercial workbook independently, including derived line items, tax treatment, multi\-year maintenance and CAMC periods, and escalation
* Proven drafting ability across DPRs, BOQs, tenders, EOIs, proposals, and formal correspondence to government departments
* Practical fluency with AI tools for document parsing, analysis, and drafting, with the discipline to verify every output against source
* Experience with consortium and JV bidding, OEM authorisation, and back\-to\-back arrangements
* Understanding of IT services and product commercial structures: AMC and CAMC, licensing, SITC, and manpower\-based contracts
* Ability to run multiple bids concurrently under hard deadlines, with zero tolerance for compliance error
* Based in Kolkata or willing to relocate

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

93185b12.title: Delivery Manager
93185b12.description:
Delivery Manager
 



 Client Delivery \& Operations • US Headquartered company
 



  





 Purpose of the Role
 



 Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients. The Delivery Manager owns the system that keeps that growth running smoothly — making on\-time, on\-scope delivery the standard across every account by owning intake, planning, capacity, cadence, and quality end to end.
 



 This is a dedicated operations role focused on one outcome: consistent, reliable delivery. It is the foundation that lets clients trust us with more work and lets the team do its best work without friction.
 



 Reporting
 



 Reports to: COO / Managing Director
 



 Works with: Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and specialists across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.
 



 Core Responsibilities
 



 1\. Own on\-time delivery across all accounts
 



 • Hold end\-to\-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.
 



 • Maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.
 



 2\. Plan capacity and resources
 



 • Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over\-allocation before it causes slippage.
 



 • Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.
 



 • Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.
 



 3\. Control intake, priorities, and scope
 



 • Run a disciplined intake process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.
 



 • Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands.
 



 • Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade\-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.
 



 4\. Run the delivery cadence
 



 • Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup \+ weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.
 



 • Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.
 



 • Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.
 



 5\. Enforce quality
 



 • Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.
 



 • For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA\-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).
 



 • Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.
 



 6\. Report to clients and leadership
 



 • Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.
 



 • Give leadership an honest, data\-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.
 



 7\. Build the delivery system
 



 • Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.
 



 • Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.
 



 • Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.
 



 What Success Looks Like (KPIs)
 



 Delivery health is measured, reviewed monthly, and owned by this role:
 



  





 Metric Target
 


1. On\-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
2. Rework rate \< 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
3. Client\-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
4. Team utilization 75–85% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
5. SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
6. Delivery visibility 100% of active work tracked in one live source of truth
7. Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after



  





 Qualifications
 



 • 5–8\+ years in project or delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.
 



 • Proven track record improving or scaling on\-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.
 



 • Working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social, creative and video production, web development, content, and analytics — enough to judge quality and timelines, not necessarily to execute hands\-on.
 



 • Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.
 



 • Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.
 



 • Strong on process design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.
 



 Ideal Candidate
 



 An operations leader who makes delivery boringly predictable. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good work ship on time — every account, every time.

579b480f.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Benchmarking
579b480f.description:
**Title:** 
 Technical Program Manager, AI Benchmarking
 



**Location:** 
 New Delhi, India
 



**Work Authorization:** 
 Current and ongoing work authorization in India
 



**Position:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Application deadline:** 
 September 18, 2026, 6 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 PxD is looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery of a national initiative benchmarking Indian AI models for agricultural advisory. Government advisory platforms are increasingly powered by large language models, and a growing set of Indian foundational models, fine\-tuned variants, and voice\-based systems have emerged as potential alternatives — but little rigorous evidence exists on how they perform inside live advisory workflows. You will run a multi\-partner benchmarking program that produces decision\-ready evidence for the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare on which models can be safely and effectively integrated into existing advisory systems.
 



  





 PxD will co\-design the benchmark framework and act as consortium facilitator and government coordination partner for this work, convening government agencies, academic technical evaluators, benchmark partners, and model providers. You will be the person who holds that consortium together day to day: setting the benchmarking architecture with government, contracting and managing academic and technical partners, overseeing the evidence pipeline from technical testing through farmer\-facing user research, and turning the results into recommendations a ministry can act on. This position is based in New Delhi, with travel to partner institutions and project states.
 



  





**About PxD:** 




  





 PxD is a rapidly scaling global non\-profit that harnesses the power of technology, data science, and behavioral economics to provide targeted information to farmers in low\- and middle\-income countries. Providing the right information to the right people, in the right way and at the right time, increases incomes, protects the environment, and improves well\-being. We are evidence\-based: we test our interventions with randomized controlled trials to prove our impact and cost\-effectiveness, to simultaneously learn from and improve our service, and to demonstrate our value to funders and partners.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





**Government \& Stakeholder Management** 




  




* Serve as PxD's day\-to\-day point of contact for the benchmarking program, working through PxD's embedded PMU team to align the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare on priority use cases, target languages and geographies, candidate models, benchmarking baselines, and approval pathways.
* Establish the governance framework for the consortium — partner roles, decision rights, steering cadence, and escalation routes — and keep it functioning as the program moves through its stages.
* Negotiate system and data access, including access to government advisory environments for substitution testing, and maintain a permissions tracker across government, academic, and advisory data sources.
* Facilitate workshops and consultations with government counterparts, model providers, and domain experts; manage the funder relationship and reporting.



  





**Benchmarking Design \& Technical Delivery** 




  




* Own the benchmarking framework end to end: advisory use cases, benchmark tasks, datasets, human\-rating rubrics, safety and language criteria, tool\-use and source\-grounding assessments, cost comparison templates, and decision thresholds.
* Work with existing benchmark initiatives to adapt and localise established assets rather than building a parallel benchmark.
* Coordinate technical benchmarking across three layers — standalone model evaluation, substitution testing within the live government advisory stack, and a neutral benchmarking harness where direct system access is unavailable — alongside assessment of speech recognition, translation, text\-to\-speech, and multilingual performance.
* Manage latency, reliability, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership analysis, and oversee the cloud compute, GPU, and API resources that represent the single largest cost line in the program.
* Safeguard the independence and neutrality of the benchmarking by maintaining clear separation between benchmark development, model evaluation, and model development roles of partner organisations, with transparent disclosure of potential conflicts of interest.



  





**Evidence Generation \& Synthesis** 




  




* Oversee pre\-deployment user evidence generation with agronomists, extension personnel, and compensated farmer participant testers, assessing whether advisory outputs are comprehensible, actionable, trustworthy, and usable in local languages.
* Manage IRB submission and third\-party field vendor selection and oversight for user testing.
* Consolidate findings across technical performance, user evidence, safety, operational readiness, and cost into a single decision framework, and translate them into recommendations a non\-technical government audience can act on.
* Author the final evidence synthesis and decision report identifying models ready for pilot deployment, models requiring further optimization, and key implementation risks.



  





**Grants, Contracts \& Partner Management** 




  




* Contract and manage academic and technical partners, sandbox and compute hosts, domain\-expert consultants, and field vendors, monitoring performance against agreed deliverables.
* Ensure contractual and donor compliance throughout implementation, including data\-processing agreements and dataset licenses.
* Coordinate with finance and operations teams on budgets, procurement, and financial reporting against grant milestones.



  





**Team \& Knowledge Management** 




  




* Work alongside research and field staff supporting the program, providing technical direction and day\-to\-day coordination.
* Document benchmarking tools, protocols, and methodology so future evaluations across agricultural and other public\-sector advisory systems can build on this work.
* Contribute to PxD's institutional knowledge management and cross\-country learning on AI advisory.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 




  





**Required** 




  




* Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Public Policy, Economics, Agriculture, Development Studies, Management, or another relevant field.
* 5–8 years of progressively responsible experience managing complex technical programs or projects.
* Working fluency with modern AI systems — LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompting, model evaluation, and the practical trade\-offs between accuracy, latency, safety, and cost.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-stakeholder projects involving government agencies, academic institutions, and external technical partners.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to run parallel workstreams against fixed donor milestones.
* Ability to translate technical evidence into clear, decision\-oriented recommendations for non\-technical senior audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building abilities.
* Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.



  





**Preferred** 




  




* Demonstrated experience with AI model evaluation (academic/ personal/ work projects).
* Direct experience designing or running model evaluations, benchmarks, or structured A/B testing of AI systems.
* Experience with Indian\-language NLP, speech technology (ASR/TTS), or multilingual model performance.
* Experience working with state or national government programs, or with digital public infrastructure.
* Background in agriculture, climate, technology, or international development.
* Familiarity with causal inference and experimental design.
* Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and limited existing infrastructure, having built or launched a new program from scratch.
* Proficiency in one or more Indian languages.



  





  





**How to apply:** 




  





 To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the application deadline of
 **Sep 18, 2026, 6 pm IST.** 




  





*PxD is committed to building an inclusive and diverse organisation. We don’t make decisions based on gender, gender identity, class, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or any other personal characteristics that are unrelated to the role. We understand that everyone has different lifestyles and we accommodate flexible working to make sure you are as productive and happy as you can be.* 




  





*We will use any personal data you provide for recruitment purposes only.*

5199eecf.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Enterprise Delivery
5199eecf.description:
**About Bureau** 




 Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision\-making engine, powered by a 1 billion\+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
 



  





 Bureau has raised $50M\+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
 



  





**Why Bureau?** 




  





 Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
 



  





 We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
 



  





**About the Role \- Sr. Technical Program Manager \- Enterprise Delivery'** 




  





 As a
 **Sr. Technical Program Manager (Senior IC)** 
 reporting directly to the
 **CTO Organization** 
 , you will be the single point of technical accountability for Bureau’s largest enterprise deployments ($25k\+ ACV) across the
 **Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI)** 
 sectors.

You will sit directly between client CTOs, engineering leads, and security reviewers, and internal software engineers, data scientists, and product managers to drive rapid Customer Time\-to\-Live (TTL) and high post\-go\-live NPS.

 Technical customer satisfaction and delivery quality score.

955a2e35.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
955a2e35.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
   

  

 But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen \- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle \- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People \> Pedigree \- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles \- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy \& Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000\+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Solutions Consultants at Razorpay are the linchpin of our enterprise sales team. You will be the technical and strategic partner to our sales team, bridging the gap between customer challenges and Razorpay's innovative payment solutions. This is not a traditional pre\-sales role; it's a chance to be a change leader and a revenue catalyst. You'll be the voice of the customer to our product team, the expert in the room with our sales team, and the trusted advisor to some of the largest enterprises.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve Big Problems: Work closely with our enterprise sales team to understand customer business goals, challenges, and technical pain points. You'll architect solutions that solve their most complex payment problems, leveraging our core products and custom capabilities. Hence in\-depth understanding of all our products is required.
* Craft Strategic Narratives: Create and deliver compelling presentations, detailed solution documents, and business proposals. You'll translate complex technical concepts into clear, executive\-level narratives that demonstrate Razorpay's unique value proposition and quantify our business value.
* Drive Revenue: Act as a critical enabler for our enterprise sales pipeline. You'll lead technical discussions, build compelling solution demonstrations, and author detailed RFP responses for major deals. Your expertise and communication will directly influence our revenue attainment goals.
* Be an Industry Expert: Drive the strategic viewpoint of the organization towards specific vertical solutions. You'll use your deep industry knowledge to be a change leader for innovative solutions that solve larger, systemic problems within a particular vertical.
* Connect the Dots: Collaborate with sales, product, and engineering teams to ensure a seamless end\-to\-end process—from solution design to successful deployment for key deals. You'll be the go\-to resource for connecting our technology to real\-world business value.
* Champion Knowledge: Contribute to our internal knowledge base and foster a culture of expertise. You'll serve as a subject matter expert, mentoring peers and authoring documentation to elevate the entire team.


**What We're Looking For**
* Problem Solver: Proven creative problem\-solving ability with a track record of leading and delivering full\-lifecycle projects. You can demonstrate how to turn complex challenges into clear, actionable solutions.
* Payments Expert: At least 3\-4 years of experience in the payments or fintech space, with a background in a product, solutions, or sales\-related role.
* Technical Practitioner: Hands\-on experience with technology is a must. You should be comfortable with APIs, technical definitions, and stitching together solutions across different platforms and partner ecosystems.
* Enterprise Advisor: Demonstrated expertise in providing advisory and guidance on large enterprise deployments and complex applications, with a history of identifying additional business opportunities.
* Influential Communicator: Exceptional verbal, presentation, and written communication skills. You have a proven ability to create and deliver technical and business\-focused presentations and documents that influence others and achieve results.
* Documentation Finesse: Established ability in crafting compelling presentations \& solution documents
* Education: An engineering background with an MBA is preferred.


 Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
