c73db191.title: Tech S And T-Cloud AI Platform Engineer-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
c73db191.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description – Manager (Cloud AI Platform Engineer)**
**Experience:** 
 10–13 years
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy \& Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands\-on cloud and AI platform engineering expertise with consulting excellence, driving end\-to\-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi\-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering Leadership**
* Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments.
* Architect scalable cloud\-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
* Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
* Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
* Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
* Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
* Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
* Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
* Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
* Build trusted relationships through hands\-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption.


**Cloud, Automation \& Deployment Engineering Leadership**
* Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
* Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
* Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
* Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
* Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
* Implement release engineering practices including blue\-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.


**MLOps, Data Pipelines \& Operationalization Leadership**
* Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
* Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
* Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real\-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud\-native data services.
* Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
* Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service\-level performance.
* Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise\-grade deployments.
* Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk\-sensitive environments.


**Asset and Accelerator Development**
* Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
* Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
* Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.


**Business Development \& GTM Initiatives**
* Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
* Develop industry\-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.


**Program Governance \& Delivery Excellence**
* Oversee end\-to\-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
* Manage cross\-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
* Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.


**Practice Development \& Team Leadership**
* Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
* Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
* Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
**Education:** 
 B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).
   

  

**Core Technical Expertise (Hands\-on Implementation Required):**
* AI Platform \& Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands\-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API\-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation \& Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering \& Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming \& APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security \& Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.


**AI and Data Science Certifications (Good to have):**
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect
* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications


**Consulting \& Leadership Experience:**
* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi\-cloud architecture programs.


**Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.
* Leadership of diverse technical teams with clear delivery focus.


**Portfolio Requirements:**
 Hands\-on experience in building production\-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

b37930e1.title: Success Architect - Sales Cloud
b37930e1.description:
**Description**
**Success Architect**
**Role Description**
 Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long\-term business success.
   

  

 Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customer's first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational 'Guide' sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long\-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long\-term success.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities
   

  

 As a Sucess Architects specializing in Sales Cloud, you will:**
* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect).
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
* Innovate \& Solve Problems – Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects.
* Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and execute playbooks from Support, Guides, and the Architect team to meet customer needs
* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.


**Basic Requirements**
 Solution Design \& Architecture
   

  

* 8\+ years of hands\-on technical experience (e.g., Senior Support Engineer, Technical Consultant, or Senior Salesforce Admin).
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices.
* Experience participating in complex implementations and understanding integration principles.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
* Familiarity with industry\- or vertical\-specific solutions (preferred).


 Communication \& Leadership
   

  

* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage customer\-facing discussions and explain technical concepts clearly.
* High proficiency in English.


 Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving
   

  

* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data\-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Desired Technical Skills


 Sales Cloud Expertise
   

  

* Strong functional and configuration knowledge of Sales Cloud features, including opportunity/pipeline management, forecasting, email integration and advanced capabilities such as Einstein Conversation Insights, Sales Engagement and Sales Performance Management.
* Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.


 Data Management \& Integration
   

  

* Proficient in understanding and troubleshooting data models, relationships (lookup/master\-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
* Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third\-party connectors.


 Secure \& Scalable Architecture
   

  

* Strong understanding of role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
* Ability to review a customer's security model for common issues.
* Skilled in identifying common anti\-patterns and escalating to senior architects for resolution.


 Salesforce Development
   

  

* Ability to read, understand, and debug APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Hands\-on development experience is a strong plus, but the primary focus is on configuration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.


 System Integration \& Extensibility
   

  

* Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event\-driven architectures.
* Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay.


**Certifications**
* Required: Salesforce Admin, Sales Cloud Consultant
* Desired: Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder

f99f5b0b.title: Cloud Security Consultant - Information Compliance Security : CNAPP, CSPM & Multi-Cloud Exp -8 - 12 Yrs | Job Location : Gurgaon, Mumbai
f99f5b0b.description:
**Company Description**
 WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI\-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI\-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human\-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**End\-to\-End Cloud Security Solution Review \& Design Assurance**
* Conduct comprehensive design and architecture reviews of end\-to\-end cloud technology solutions, including cloud platforms (M365, Azure, AWS) and SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS implementations, ensuring security by design.
* Perform in\-depth technical assessments of implemented technology solutions (on\-premises and cloud) to identify misconfigurations, deviations from best practices, and potential attack vectors.
* Evaluate cloud security solutions against threat models, risk assessments, and industry\-recognized frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks).
* Provide expert security recommendations and architectural guidance to Risk, InfoSec, and Enterprise IT leadership, as well as to client\-facing processes.


**Cloud Security Posture Management \& Compliance Assurance**
* Lead and execute Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) reviews using CNAPP (Cloud\-Native Application Protection Platform) tools to assess cloud security posture, cloud identity protection (CIEM), workload protection, and container security.
* Run regular compliance scans of cloud resources against standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, and SOC 2, and drive continuous improvement of compliance posture.
* Review and provide feedback on cloud security policies, procedures, and hardening documents, ensuring alignment with CIS benchmarks and organizational InfoSec policies.
* Conduct cloud risk assessments to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and misconfigurations that could impact IT operations and sensitive data.


**Secure Cloud Development \& Operations Practices**
* Collaborate with Enterprise IT and DevOps teams to embed security throughout the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines.
* Review Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates and automation scripts for security flaws, guiding teams on secure IaC best practices.
* Participate in cloud attack path analysis to understand adversary techniques and design preventative and detective controls.
* Ensure CIS and other security best practices are rigorously applied across new and existing applications, products, and cloud infrastructure.


**Security Governance \& Remediation Oversight**
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to track and drive remediation of identified security vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud security governance frameworks and processes.
* Act as a subject matter expert for incident response and forensic readiness related to cloud security incidents.
* Collaborate on cloud attack path analysis across teams.


**Qualifications**
**Experience**
* 8–12\+ years of progressive experience in Information Security, with at least 5–7 years focused specifically on cloud security architecture, engineering, and review.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with security services and features across major cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Demonstrable experience performing security assessments, penetration testing, or vulnerability management within cloud environments.
* Proven experience designing and reviewing secure cloud architectures for complex enterprise solutions.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of cloud computing principles (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and the Shared Responsibility Model.
* Expertise in cloud security frameworks and standards: NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Cloud Top 10\.
* Hands\-on proficiency with leading CNAPP platforms (e.g., Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Tenable, Lacework, Microsoft, CrowdStrike Cloud Security) for CSPM, CIEM, cloud workload protection, and container security.
* Strong grasp of Identity and Access Management (IAM) in the cloud: Azure AD, AWS IAM, GCP IAM, conditional access policies, MFA, SSO, PIM/PAM.
* Advanced knowledge of network security in the cloud: VPC/VNet design, network segmentation, firewalls (WAF, NGFW), security groups/NSGs, VPNs, and private links.
* Expertise in data security and encryption, including securing data at rest and in transit using native cloud encryption services (KMS, Key Vault, Cloud KMS).
* Understanding of application security in the cloud, including secure coding practices, API security, serverless function security, and DevSecOps integration.
* Ability to review and secure Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates, Bicep) and policy\-as\-code implementations.
* Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and associated security best practices and tools.


**Compliance \& Governance**
* In\-depth knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001\) and their application in cloud environments.
* Experience with GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) tools and processes for cloud.


**Analytical \& Communication Skills**
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Strong ability to articulate complex security concepts and risks to technical and non\-technical audiences alike.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for documentation, reports, and presentations.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a distributed team, managing multiple priorities effectively.


**Certifications (Highly Preferred)**
*Cloud Security Certifications:*
* (ISC)² Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK)


*General Security Certifications:*
* (ISC)² CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

011c0daf.title: Associate Programme Delivery Manager/Associate Director, Tech Center Programme Delivery
011c0daf.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Tech Center Programme Delivery


In this role you will:

* Strategic portfolio delivery leadership : Lead the Tech Centre India strategic change portfolio end\-to\-end, translating strategy into an executable plan with clear outcomes, ownership, milestones and timelines. Ensure delivery progress is measurable and transparent.
* Executive advisory and decision enablement :Partner closely with the Head of Tech Centre India and the Executive Management team to advise on priorities, trade\-offs and sequencing. Drive timely decisions by presenting concise options, implications, and recommended actions.
* Programme governance, controls and quality discipline :Establish and run robust governance aligned to Group standards (e.g., BTF), including project controls, QA processes, RAID management and dependency mapping. Maintain reporting cadence and ensure exceptions are clearly flagged with mitigation and decision requests.
* Operating model and organisational effectiveness :Review and shape organisational structure improvements, identify capability/skills gaps, and drive actions to close those gaps. Improve ways of working, clarify accountabilities, and streamline execution across functions.
* Cross\-team coordination and blocker removal :Connect teams working on related initiatives, manage interdependencies, and proactively remove delivery constraints. Escalate issues early and drive resolution or sponsor decisions within agreed timeframes.
* Stakeholder management and governance hygiene :Run decision\-led governance forums (ExCo/SteerCo/working groups), ensuring agendas and papers are issued in advance and minutes/actions are distributed promptly. Maintain stakeholder distribution lists and coordinate consistent communications.
* Executive communications and reputation management :Act as a communications arm for the leadership team, shaping and delivering an integrated communications approach aligned to GCIO strategies. Coordinate content for internal and external forums to strengthen business reputation and positioning.
* Leadership engagement, events and community building :Plan and deliver leadership visits, offsites, all\-hands and townhalls (including content curation), and leadership exchange meetings. Ensure communications and events land well with employees and drive clarity, engagement and alignment.
* People agenda and culture stewardship :Contribute to and drive the people agenda for the Global Tech Centres, with a focus on culture, employee wellbeing and engagement. Serve as a trusted liaison between staff, senior leaders and executives.
* DEI sponsorship and representation : Act as a working DEI sponsor, representing the Head of HTI in DEI working groups/CWGs. Provide a sounding board for DEI initiatives and help convert ideas into practical, measurable actions.
* Executive operations and meeting effectiveness :Prepare materials for workshops, conferences, meetings and offsites, including drafting presentations and managing document flow. Ensure leadership time is used effectively through crisp briefs, clear decisions and disciplined follow\-through.
* Financial oversight and operational management : Track portfolio costs against budget, maintain forecast accuracy, and manage workloads efficiently across self/team. Ensure artefacts are stored appropriately and retrievable quickly to support audit and governance needs.
* Risk, compliance and audit readiness :Uphold HSBC internal control standards, drive closure of audit points and issues raised by regulators, and manage compliance risk in partnership with relevant compliance stakeholders. Ensure early engagement on new initiatives and maintain appropriate evidence and records.
* Tech–Ops–Business alignment leadership :Lead collaboration across Technology, Operations and Business to align on shared outcomes (delivery, resilience, controls and people). Build accountability by ensuring Tier\-1 initiatives have named sponsors, owners and success metrics.


In this role, you will:

* Post\-graduate degree in management or technology from a reputed university is desirable. Evidence of continuous learning in programme leadership, communications, governance or transformation is beneficial.
* Proven experience in similar leadership roles : Demonstrable success in Chief of Staff / strategic delivery / transformation programme roles, ideally within large, complex organisations. Track record should be measurable and referenceable, showing tangible outcomes delivered.
* Strong executive stakeholder management :Extensive experience engaging CxO\-level and senior leadership stakeholders, building confidence through clarity, predictability and disciplined follow\-through. Comfortable influencing without direct authority across multiple sponsors and priorities.
* Programme and portfolio management capability :Strong hands\-on experience with portfolio planning, milestone management, RAID and dependency mapping, and structured governance routines. Able to run decision\-led SteerCos/ExCos and sustain a high\-quality reporting cadence.

* Networking and cross\-functional coordination : Strong experience coordinating across organisational functions, geographies and time zones, connecting teams working on similar initiatives. Skilled at aligning diverse perspectives towards shared outcomes.

TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
   

  

**Team Overview**
 As an Automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Delivery Lead within Global Operations, you will lead one of the delivery pods responsible for executing a portfolio of technology\-enabled solutions across transformation programs. This role is accountable for managing a multidisciplinary technical team delivering solutions across intelligent automation, AI/ML, workflow automation, and pro\-code application development, with a strong focus on driving measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 You will be responsible for leading technical delivery resources, applying hands\-on solution architecture experience to guide implementation decisions, translating approved solution designs into scalable and sustainable delivery plans, and ensuring solutions are delivered in alignment with enterprise strategy, governance, architecture, and performance expectations. AI/ML remains a significant area of focus and direction of travel, but the role spans a broader set of solution types needed to modernize operational workflows.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with the Design team, Capability Development team, Global Operations, Global Technology, Data Science \& Analytics, and other solution partners to move prioritized opportunities from design into execution and deliver integrated, scalable solutions that create measurable business value. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in\-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
   

  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
**Solution Delivery Leadership**
* Lead a delivery pod responsible for executing technology\-enabled solutions across intelligent automation, AI/ML, workflow automation, and pro\-code application development.
* Translate approved business and solution designs into actionable delivery plans, milestones, and implementation outcomes.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, sustainable, and aligned with capability standards, governance frameworks, enterprise architecture, and operational performance expectations, using hands\-on architecture experience to guide key delivery decisions.


**Collaboration with Design and Capability Development**
* Partner with Solution Design leads to receive and refine solution designs, clarify delivery requirements, and support smooth transition from design into execution.

* Communicate solution strategy, progress, and impact to senior stakeholders.
* Facilitate cross\-functional alignment across Global Operations, Technology, Data Science, Solution Design, and Capability Development teams.


**Talent \& Resource Management**
* Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary technical delivery team, including resources supporting automation, AI/ML, workflow automation, and application development initiatives.
* Support skill development and promote a culture of innovation and experimentation.
* Manage resource allocation and team structure to support agile delivery.


**Delivery Governance**
* Ensure delivered solutions meet compliance, risk, security, ethical AI, operational readiness, and performance standards.
* Participate in governance forums to review solution progress, risks, and alignment.
* Maintain transparency and accountability throughout the delivery lifecycle.


**Key Competencies**

* Technology\-Enabled Solution Delivery
* Intelligent Automation, AI/ML, Workflow Automation \& Application Delivery
* Hands\-On Solution Architecture \& Technical Delivery Leadership
* Strategic Thinking
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration with Design, Capability, Technology, and Operations Teams
* Governance \& Compliance
* Innovation, Experimentation \& Practical Delivery Execution
* Technical Team Leadership \& Coaching
* Communication \& Influence

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Operations, Transformation, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience leading technology\-enabled transformation, automation, AI/ML, workflow, or application delivery initiatives, with 5\+ years in leadership roles.
* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary technical teams to deliver enterprise\-scale solutions that improve operational performance.
* Hands\-on technical and solution architecture experience across intelligent automation, AI/ML\-enabled solutions, workflow automation, and application delivery, with the ability to guide technical teams, assess implementation trade\-offs, and ensure delivery decisions align with enterprise standards.

* Familiarity with delivery governance, risk management, compliance expectations, ethical AI practices, and enterprise technology standards.

4568221a.description:
**Company Description** 
 Microair Avionics is a technology\-driven avionics company with over 25 years of experience designing and manufacturing lightweight, energy\-efficient, and cost\-effective solutions for GA, SA, and UAV applications. All products are engineered and produced in Queensland, Australia, and supported through a global network for customer care, warranties, and technical assistance. The company’s portfolio includes pioneering radios and transponders such as the M720 VHF Comm, the compact M760 radio, and the T2000 series, which successfully expanded into both UAV and GA markets. Microair Avionics is committed to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and reliable support for customers worldwide.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Program Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Indore, responsible for leading end\-to\-end delivery of avionics programs from planning through execution and completion. This role oversees project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation, ensuring alignment with engineering, manufacturing, sales, and customer support teams. The Program Manager will coordinate cross\-functional communication, manage risks and issues, and maintain program documentation and reporting for internal stakeholders. In addition, the role involves monitoring quality standards, facilitating continuous improvement initiatives, and supporting customers and partners with timely updates on program status and product milestones.
   

**Qualifications**
* Program and project management skills, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional teams in engineering, manufacturing, and customer support.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present status reports and technical information clearly.
* Background in aviation, aerospace, electronics, or related technology\-driven industries is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, project management, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2\) are an advantage.
* Proven ability to work on\-site, manage multiple programs concurrently, and adapt to evolving priorities.
* Familiarity with quality management systems and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) is a plus.

1a64bc75.title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
1a64bc75.description:
**Company:** 
 Free Stand Sampling Solutions Pvt. Ltd. ("FreeStand") 
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi \& Mumbai, close to the founding team and our enterprise clients. 
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time · Early/founding hire · High ownership 
 



**Reports to:** 
 \[Founder / CBO]
 



  





**Read this before you apply** 




  





 Most "customer success" jobs are relationship\-management jobs: QBRs, check\-ins, a calendar full of cadence. This is not that.This is a
 **builder's seat.** 
 You'll be measured on getting blue\-chip FMCG brands
 *live, instrumented and expanding* 
   not on meeting frequency. You'll configure our internal tooling yourself, build the demo a brand evaluates, wire up their dashboards, write the SQL, and clear the legal and operational steps between a signed contract and a working campaign. When our defaults don't fit a brand's ask, you won't escalate and wait, you'll design the workaround.We're upfront about this because the people who thrive here read that and get
 *excited* 
 , not deterred. If you want a polished account\-management role with a comfortable cadence, this isn't it. If you want to own outcomes in ambiguity, get your hands into the tooling and the data, and
 *define a function* 
 rather than inherit one, keep reading.
 



  





**About FreeStand** 




 FreeStand is a
 **digital sampling and customer\-engagement platform for FMCG brands.** 
 Founded in 2019 and built in Delhi, we help brands plan, execute, monitor and audit product\-sampling campaigns digitally \- putting the right sample in the right consumer's hands at the right moment, and turning every sample into a measurable customer\-engagement opportunity. We run campaigns for brands across India, managed from our Delhi base.
 



 A few things worth knowing about who you'd be joining:
 


* **We work with the biggest names in FMCG.** 
 FreeStand is the sampling partner of choice for 40\+ brands, including
 **L'Oréal (CeraVe), HUL, Nestlé, Nivea, Reckitt, Emami, Mars Petcare, Cipla (Nicotex) and Piramal (Little's).**
* **Our campaigns operate at real scale.** 
 Individual launches have reached
 **10M\+ consumers** 
 (e.g. L'Oréal CeraVe's India launch and Nivea's first\-party\-data campaign), with customer\-satisfaction scores above 95% on programmes like Piramal Little's.
* **We're backed and recognised.** 
 FreeStand is backed by
 **Venture Catalysts, SucSEED Indovation and Nocking Point Advisors** 
 across multiple seed rounds, and has been recognised by the
 **Google for Startups Accelerator (Women Founders cohort)** 
 ,
 **IIM Calcutta Innovation Park** 
 and
 **I\-Venture @ ISB** 
 .
* **We're founder\-led and lean.** 
 You will work directly with the founders, your decisions will be visible every single day, and your wins will be felt immediately.



  





 Here's the part most candidates miss:
 **signing a blue\-chip brand is the start, not the finish.** 
 The gap between a signed contract and a live, instrumented, expanding campaign is exactly where enterprise deals are won or lost.
 *That gap is what this role owns.* 
 When a brand like L'Oréal or HUL trusts FreeStand, you are the person who turns that trust into a working, measurable campaign and into the next one.
 



  





**The role** 




 You own what happens after a brand signs, and part of what happens just before. You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring our internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live. When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
 



 This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands
 *live, instrumented, and expanding,* 
 not on meeting cadence.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result accounts that stay live and grow
 *because they're properly instrumented* 
 . Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function. The playbook you build becomes the product that the next deployment runs on.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* **4–7 years** 
 in solutions engineering, implementation/onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech, or adtech company.
* **Hands\-on data fluency:** 
 You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* **Ownership in ambiguity:** 
 You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* **Enterprise stakeholder management:** 
 You've sat across from brand/marketing, procurement and legal, ideally in or around FMCG/CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu) and moved them.
* **Communication:** 
 Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.Bonus
* Exposure to FMCG / CPG brand\-marketing teams or agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Light scripting (Python / JS), API / integration comfort, or hands\-on use of AI / LLM tooling.
* Experience at a company with a forward\-deployed or solutions\-led delivery model.



  





**Your first year** 




 This role has a clear arc \- from shipping your first brand to owning the function.
 


* **Months 0 to 3 \- Your first deployment.** 
 Take one signed brand from contract to live, instrumented campaign, end\-to\-end. Learn our tooling, our brands and our defaults cold. By the end, you've shipped something real.
* **Months 3 to 6 \- Your own book.** 
 Run multiple enterprise deployments independently. Every account lives, dashboarded and adopted without hand\-holding. Time\-to\-live trending down as you build repeatable patterns.
* **Months 6 to 12 \- Define the function.** 
 Turn your patterns into SOPs and tooling specs with Product, set the standard for how FreeStand deploys enterprise brands and lay the groundwork for the team you'll eventually lead.



 You won't be left to sink: direct access to the founders, real authority to unblock, and clear targets. What you won't get is vagueness about what success means, and that's by design.
 



  





**How we'll measure success (first 6–12 months)** 




 The metric we obsess over first:
 **time from contract signed to first live campaign.** 
 Everything else compounds from there:
 


* **Activation:** 
 dashboards and analytics delivered and adopted, per account.
* **Retention:** 
 gross retention and health of your book of enterprise accounts.
* **Expansion:** 
 growth influenced within existing accounts.
* **Product impact:** 
 feedback converted into shipped tooling.



  





 Clear ownership, clear outcomes. This is what makes the role serious and what makes the trajectory below real when you deliver.
 



  





**Why this role \- and where it goes** 




 You'll join early, with high ownership, at an AI\-native company working with blue\-chip consumer brands. You won't just operate a process \- you'll
 **define this function and help build the tooling that powers it.** 




 That's also the path forward. The person who builds FreeStand's forward\-deployed delivery motion from the ground up and proves it converts signed brands into live, expanding accounts is first in line to lead this function as it grows: more accounts, a team to build, and the same playbook stood up as FreeStand scales beyond India. This is a genuine, named prospect of the role, not a vague promise.
 



  





**Compensation** 




 Competitive fixed salary, outcome\-linked variable, and meaningful ESOPs.
 



 ₹15L fixed \+ ₹5L variable \+ ESOPs
 



  





**Selection process** 




 We're selective about this one, on purpose.
 


1. Fill out the application form with short notes.
2. A solutioning working session: we'll put a real FreeStand brand scenario in front of you and build the campaign configuration together.
3. A short analytics task shows us how you'd stand up a dashboard that a brand would actually use.
4. Final conversation with the entire team.



  





 If owning outcomes in ambiguity excites you and building the function does too, apply. We're moving fast.
 



 FreeStand is a women\-led, equal\-opportunity workplace. Made with care in Delhi.

2a777778.title: Program Manager
2a777778.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Position Title

**Program Manager**

Department

Engineering

Reports To

Engineering Manager

Direct Reports

* Nil standing direct reports; a graduate engineer or program coordinator may be assigned.
* Matrix leadership of cross\-functional program teams drawn from Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial.

Position Overview

The Program Manager is accountable for the delivery of Microair Avionics' OEM customer programs and internal development projects, several running concurrently at different stages of maturity.

Based at Microair's Indore facility and working across the company's Australian, US, Irish and Indian operations, the role converts customer commitments into achievable plans, keeps those plans honest as they meet reality, and removes whatever stands between the delivery team and the outcome.

Authority is held over program scope, schedule baseline, budget and risk disposition within the approved contract, and the position is the delegated voice of Microair to the customer on program matters.

Leadership is exercised through influence rather than line authority: the team creates the value, and the Program Manager's job is to enable it.

Key Responsibilities1\. Program Ownership

Hold end\-to\-end accountability for multiple concurrent OEM delivery programs and development projects, from contract award through certification to entry into service and closeout.

2\. Scope Translation \& Planning

Dissect the customer statement of work into a detailed, resourced and achievable plan — work breakdown, schedule, milestones and dependencies — expressed so the delivery team and the customer work from the same picture.

3\. Team Enablement

Operate on the basis that the team creates customer and company value, not the manager. Clear roadblocks, protect focus, and secure the resources and decisions the team is waiting on, including those held in another time zone.

4\. Influence Without Authority

Secure commitment, priority and follow\-through from peers and their teams across Engineering, Operations, Quality and Commercial — and across the Indian, Australian, Irish and US sites — without relying on positional authority.

5\. Customer Engagement

Act as the principal customer\-facing contact for assigned programs and represent Microair credibly at OEM design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and program gates, contributing to the technical discussion rather than deferring it.

6\. Risk \& Opportunity Management

Run living risk and opportunity registers on every program, on the basis that unmanaged risk is the most likely cause of schedule slip. Own mitigations to closure and pursue opportunities with equal discipline.

7\. Schedule, Cost \& Revenue

Own program schedule, cost and revenue performance. Maintain credible forecasts, manage milestone claims and revenue timing, and escalate early and with options.

8\. Change \& Variation Control

Identify scope change as it emerges, assess the schedule and cost impact, and agree variations with the customer before the work is quietly absorbed.

9\. Value Realisation

Define how the value created by each program is measured, and test that against what the customer expects and pays for, so any gap surfaces while there is still time to act.

Skills \& ExperienceEducation

* Bachelor degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in engineering or a related technical discipline — essential.
* Formal program or project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent) — desirable.
* A substantial delivery track record is accepted in lieu of formal qualifications.

Experience

* Minimum 8 years in engineering or technical delivery, including 4 years managing programs in their own right — essential.
* Demonstrated ownership of several concurrent customer programs and development projects — essential.
* Met schedule, cost and revenue commitments on fixed\-price and milestone\-based contracts — essential.
* Managed distributed teams and customers across Indian, Australian, European and US time zones — essential.
* Fluent professional English; willing to travel internationally to customer and Microair sites — essential.
* Aerospace or avionics background — desirable; equivalent experience in another regulated safety\-critical domain (defence electronics, automotive functional safety, medical devices, rail) is accepted.
* Exposure to STC and TSO/ETSO certification schedules — desirable.

System Knowledge

* Scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera or equivalent) and Microsoft 365 to intermediate Excel — essential.
* Yogi for requirements and Xray for verification traceability, sufficient to read program status from the tools rather than from status meetings — desirable.
* Dynamics 365 Business Central for cost, purchasing and material visibility — desirable.
* Aircraft systems and avionics architecture sufficient to hold a technical conversation with an OEM; working awareness of ARP4754B, ARP4761A, DO\-160, DO\-178C and DO\-254 — valued.

Pay: ₹726,115\.68 \- ₹1,226,025\.36 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

1a9c1088.title: Sr. Program Manager, Brand Protections
1a9c1088.description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
   

  

 The IPP team designs and builds high\-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross\-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single\-threaded owner for end\-to\-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.
   

  

**Role**
 We are seeking a strategic, experienced Senior Program Manager to own the strategy, execution, and cross\-organizational integration for Band Protections — turning reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention that directly reduces brand abuse for rights owners globally. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high\-ambiguity brand protection challenges with senior leadership visibility
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self\-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space
* Drive clear communication channels and strategic stakeholder engagement for both internal teams and external brand partners globally
* This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role requiring exceptional judgment, the ability to shape strategy from scratch, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You will work across 5\+ teams and multiple geographies, building solutions that protect millions of brands and strengthen the trustworthiness of Amazon's marketplace.


 This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Identify and resolve ambiguity across organizational boundaries — scoping problems, proposing solutions, and driving alignment where no playbook exists.
* Analyze defects trends, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs
* Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross\-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
* Manage competing priorities across regional teams, making trade\-off recommendations and surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions.
* Own complex enforcement decisions in ambiguous, high\-stakes situations, setting precedents that scale across geographies


**About The Team**
 The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**

22d45ab3.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Tech Center Programme Delivery
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Strategic portfolio delivery leadership : Lead the Tech Centre India strategic change portfolio end\-to\-end, translating strategy into an executable plan with clear outcomes, ownership, milestones and timelines. Ensure delivery progress is measurable and transparent.
* Executive advisory and decision enablement : Partner closely with the Head of Tech Centre India and the Executive Management team to advise on priorities, trade\-offs and sequencing. Drive timely decisions by presenting concise options, implications, and recommended actions.
* Programme governance, controls and quality discipline : Establish and run robust governance aligned to Group standards (e.g., BTF), including project controls, QA processes, RAID management and dependency mapping. Maintain reporting cadence and ensure exceptions are clearly flagged with mitigation and decision requests.
* Operating model and organisational effectiveness : Review and shape organisational structure improvements, identify capability/skills gaps, and drive actions to close those gaps. Improve ways of working, clarify accountabilities, and streamline execution across functions.
* Cross\-team coordination and blocker removal : Connect teams working on related initiatives, manage interdependencies, and proactively remove delivery constraints. Escalate issues early and drive resolution or sponsor decisions within agreed timeframes.
* Stakeholder management and governance hygiene : Run decision\-led governance forums (ExCo/SteerCo/working groups), ensuring agendas and papers are issued in advance and minutes/actions are distributed promptly. Maintain stakeholder distribution lists and coordinate consistent communications.
* Executive communications and reputation management : Act as a communications arm for the leadership team, shaping and delivering an integrated communications approach aligned to GCIO strategies. Coordinate content for internal and external forums to strengthen business reputation and positioning.
* Leadership engagement, events and community building : Plan and deliver leadership visits, offsites, all\-hands and townhalls (including content curation), and leadership exchange meetings. Ensure communications and events land well with employees and drive clarity, engagement and alignment.
* People agenda and culture stewardship : Contribute to and drive the people agenda for the Global Tech Centres, with a focus on culture, employee wellbeing and engagement. Serve as a trusted liaison between staff, senior leaders and executives.
* DEI sponsorship and representation : Act as a working DEI sponsor, representing the Head of HTI in DEI working groups/CWGs. Provide a sounding board for DEI initiatives and help convert ideas into practical, measurable actions.
* Executive operations and meeting effectiveness : Prepare materials for workshops, conferences, meetings and offsites, including drafting presentations and managing document flow. Ensure leadership time is used effectively through crisp briefs, clear decisions and disciplined follow\-through.
* Financial oversight and operational management : Track portfolio costs against budget, maintain forecast accuracy, and manage workloads efficiently across self/team. Ensure artefacts are stored appropriately and retrievable quickly to support audit and governance needs.
* Risk, compliance and audit readiness : Uphold HSBC internal control standards, drive closure of audit points and issues raised by regulators, and manage compliance risk in partnership with relevant compliance stakeholders. Ensure early engagement on new initiatives and maintain appropriate evidence and records.
* Tech–Ops–Business alignment leadership : Lead collaboration across Technology, Operations and Business to align on shared outcomes (delivery, resilience, controls and people). Build accountability by ensuring Tier\-1 initiatives have named sponsors, owners and success metrics.


**In This Role, You Will**
* Post\-graduate degree in management or technology from a reputed university is desirable. Evidence of continuous learning in programme leadership, communications, governance or transformation is beneficial.
* Proven experience in similar leadership roles : Demonstrable success in Chief of Staff / strategic delivery / transformation programme roles, ideally within large, complex organisations. Track record should be measurable and referenceable, showing tangible outcomes delivered.
* Strong executive stakeholder management : Extensive experience engaging CxO\-level and senior leadership stakeholders, building confidence through clarity, predictability and disciplined follow\-through. Comfortable influencing without direct authority across multiple sponsors and priorities.
* Programme and portfolio management capability : Strong hands\-on experience with portfolio planning, milestone management, RAID and dependency mapping, and structured governance routines. Able to run decision\-led SteerCos/ExCos and sustain a high\-quality reporting cadence.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and drive outcomes : Evidence of success in roles with shifting priorities and unclear problem statements, bringing analytical rigour and structure. Able to frame problems, evaluate options, and drive practical solutions at pace.
* High\-impact communication and executive writing : Excellent communication skills across written, verbal and presentation formats, including creation of management packs, decks and briefings for very senior audiences. Able to simplify complex topics and make decisions easier.
* Networking and cross\-functional coordination : Strong experience coordinating across organisational functions, geographies and time zones, connecting teams working on similar initiatives. Skilled at aligning diverse perspectives towards shared outcomes.
* Governance, controls and audit discipline : Strong understanding of governance artefacts, audit requirements and internal control standards, with proven ability to close control gaps. Able to maintain audit\-ready documentation, evidence and timely remediation tracking.
* Operational effectiveness and delivery rhythm : Able to manage workload effectively, prioritise competing demands, and escalate early with clear options and recommendations. Strong attention to detail with reliable follow\-through on actions and commitments.
* Financial and commercial awareness : Experience tracking programme spend, managing budgets and forecasts, and maintaining financial discipline within approved tolerances. Comfortable linking spend to outcomes and benefits where quantification is challenging.
* Leadership capabilities aligned to HSBC expectations : Demonstrates the ability to navigate (align direction), aspire (raise standards), drive (deliver stretching goals), mobilise (engage stakeholders), and sustain (protect values, reputation and long\-term outcomes).
* People, culture and engagement orientation : Experience supporting people agenda initiatives (engagement, wellbeing, culture), and running leadership engagement events that improve clarity and connection. Able to foster accountability while maintaining a supportive team environment.
* DEI mindset and sponsorship experience (advantage) : Exposure to DEI sponsorship, employee networks or working groups, and a practical approach to embedding inclusion into programmes, communications and leadership engagement.


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

**Description**
 At Amazon, we are always exploring new opportunities to shape our global business. As a Program Manager I, you will play a key role in executing and improving programs that drive operational excellence. Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000\+ employees and 24,000\+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.


Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

 **AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**


Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.


Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.


If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.


For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud

 **About the role:**
We have a rewarding and lucrative position in the PSG\-Dedicated Solution Builder team for Graduates. In This Role, You Will::

* Provide exceptional customer service which results in renewals

Here's What You Need::

 Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions.  We are looking for a Workplace Solutions \& Identity Integration Engineer with 3–6 years of experience to support the design, integration, deployment, and operation of cloud and SaaS based workplace platforms. The candidate should have hands on experience with enterprise identity and access management, SSO, MFA, and security integration.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 Key Responsibilities

* Ensure solutions follow enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and governance standards.
* Collaborate with workplace, infrastructure, security, IAM, and application teams for seamless platform integration.
* Troubleshoot authentication, access, and integration related issues and provide timely resolution.
* Support operational activities including platform monitoring, incident management, and service requests.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration details, integration documents, and operational procedures.
* Identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement in workplace and identity management processes.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3–6 years of experience in Workplace Solutions, Digital Workplace, Cloud/SaaS Platforms, IAM, or Application Integration.
* Hands on experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Good understanding of SSO, MFA, IAM, RBAC, and user access management.
* Knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols such as SAML, OAuth 2\.0, and OIDC.
* Experience integrating cloud/SaaS applications with enterprise identity platforms.
* Understanding of enterprise security, access controls, and compliance requirements.
* Basic experience with automation using PowerShell, APIs, or workflow tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem solving skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with multiple technical and business stakeholders.


**Preferred Skills**
 Required qualifications to be successful in this role
   

  

* Workplace Technology Platforms – SaaS workplace solutions, Micoroft 365, MS Places, Smart office and digital workplace tools
* Solution Design \& Integrations – APIs, SaaS integrations, Azure AD/SSO, technical solution design.
* IoT \& Smart Building Technologies – Sensors, occupancy monitoring, gateways and workplace automation
* Knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) concepts.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, including Incident and Change Management.
* Relevant certifications in Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Security, IAM, or Cloud technologies are preferred.


 Secondary Skill Sets
   

  

 Data \& Analytics – Dashboarding, KPI tracking, office analytics and usage insights.
   

  

 CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs
   

  

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
 Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
   

  

 You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
   

  

 Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
   

  

 You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
   

  

 That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
   

  

 Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
