e49deb93.title: Senior Linux Administrator & AWS Cloud Engineer
e49deb93.description:
Company Profile:  

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: Linux Admin \& AWS Cloud Engineer  

Position: SSE/LA  

Experience: 8\-10 years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering  

Shift: 5:30 PM, to 2:30 AM IST  

Main location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai  

Position ID: J0826\-2064  

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 08 years of relevant experience.  

  

Position Overview  

We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive Senior Linux Administrator \& AWS Cloud Engineer with 8 to 10 years of hands on technical experience to join our IT Infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, deploying, configuring, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise grade Linux servers and AWS cloud infrastructure.  

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Linux operating systems (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS, Ubuntu), robust cloud management skills in Amazon Web Services (AWS), and strong capabilities in automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), performance tuning, security hardening, and high availability operations.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

1\. Linux System Administration \& Engineering  

  

. Provision, configure, and maintain Linux enterprise environments (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky Linux, Ubuntu Server).  

. Perform advanced system administration tasks including OS upgrades, patch management, kernel tuning, user access management, and package management (yum, dnf, apt).  

. Manage storage subsystems, including Logical Volume Management (LVM), SAN/NAS mounts, NFS, and file system maintenance.  

. Troubleshooting complex operating system, hardware, networking, and application performance issues.  

  

2\. AWS Cloud Infrastructure Management  

  

. Architect, build, and manage scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure on AWS.  

. Operate core AWS services including EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, EBS, EFS, Route 53, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling Groups, RDS, and ElastiCache.  

. Manage containerized workloads using Docker and AWS container services (ECS / EKS).  

. Implement cost optimization and resource usage strategies (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, right sizing).  

  

3\. Automation \& Infrastructure as Code (IaC)  

  

. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployments using Terraform, CloudFormation, and Ansible.  

. Write and maintain robust shell scripts (Bash) and Python scripts for system monitoring, task automation, and maintenance routines.  

. Build and integrate deployment pipelines using CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).  

  

4\. Security, Compliance \& System Hardening  

  

. Enforce enterprise security standards, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability scanning, and OS hardening procedures.  

. Manage AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) role policies, security groups, network ACLs, and SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle.  

. Participate in internal and external audit compliance processes (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS).  

  

5\. Operations, High Availability \& Disaster Recovery  

  

. Ensure system reliability, uptime, and high availability across multi AZ AWS environments.  

. Design, test, and execute Backup and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.  

. Monitor system metrics, setup automated alerts, and respond to critical system incidents.  

. Serve as a senior technical escalation point and participate in an on call rotation schedule.  

  

  

Required Qualifications \& Technical Skills  

  

. Experience: 8–10 years of dedicated experience in Linux System Administration, with at least 4\+ years of hands on experience managing production AWS environments.  

. Linux OS Expertise: Strong proficiency with RHEL / CentOS / Ubuntu, command line utilities, systemd, boot sequences, and kernel diagnostics.  

. AWS Expertise: Proven track record in managing enterprise AWS architectures, networking (VPC peering, Transit Gateway, VPNs), and IAM governance.  

. Configuration Management \& IaC: Hands on experience with Terraform and Ansible for environment provisioning and configuration.  

. Scripting: Proficiency in Bash and Python for automation.  

. Networking \& Security: Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSH, Firewalld/IPTables, VPN, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and routing.  

. Database Administration Support: Experience supporting Linux based database servers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Oracle).  

. Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, System Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.  

  

  

Preferred Certifications \& Plus Points  

  

. AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional  

. Linux Certifications: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)  

. Experience with: Kubernetes / EKS administration Monitoring platforms like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic Infrastructure compliance frameworks

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

5fde5621.description:
**About the Role** 




 AvanteNow is delivering a large\-scale ServiceNow platform transformation for a major bank in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), consolidating IT Service Management, IT Operations, CMDB/Discovery, IT Asset Management, Governance Risk \& Compliance (GRC/IRM), Business Continuity Management, Third\-Party Risk Management and Data Privacy onto a single enterprise platform. We are hiring experienced ServiceNow professionals to join the delivery team for this programme.
 



 As Project Manager, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of this ServiceNow transformation programme, leading a distributed team across Riyadh and India, and acting as the primary point of contact for the bank's stakeholders.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Hold overall accountability for project delivery: scope, schedule, cost, quality and resourcing across all workstreams.
* Maintain the project plan, schedule and cost baseline; produce Gantt\-based work plans and track milestones by phase.
* Chair the project steering committee and issue weekly progress reporting to the bank's stakeholders.
* Own and maintain the project risk register covering all risk categories, including security risk, with mitigation actions and status tracking.
* Manage the change\-control process, including coordination with the bank's Information Security (EIS) approval process for all platform configuration and workflow changes.
* Coordinate resource management and interfaces across functional, technical and quality workstreams and with the bank's Change Management team.
* Own formal stage\-gate sign\-off at the end of each implementation phase.
* Set up and run the Programme Office, including issue management and communications/reporting cadence.



**Required Skills \& Experience** 




 10\+ years of IT project/programme management experience; 5\+ years leading ServiceNow or comparable enterprise platform implementations; prior delivery experience in banking or other regulated financial services, ideally in the GCC/KSA; strong stakeholder, budget, schedule and subcontractor management skills.
 



**Certifications** 




 PMP or PRINCE2 (mandatory); ITIL4 Foundation; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and/or Agile/Scrum certification are an advantage.

bd95acde.title: Technical Program Manager, Google Pay, Recurring Payments
bd95acde.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management.
* Experience working on consumer\-facing mobile applications and high\-frequency transactional/utility products in the FinTech, Payments, or Commerce industry.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in applying modern AI/ML tools, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agent\-based automation to advance technical program management practices (e.g., autonomous dependency tracking, predictive risk analysis, and process optimization).
* Experience collaborating effectively with distributed Engineering, Product Management, Partnerships, UX, Legal, Compliance, and Finance teams.
* Understanding of the India digital payments and utility ecosystem, including UPI, Bharat Connect, regulatory landscape (RBI, NPCI), and key market players.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google Pay India is at the forefront of India's digital payments revolution. We build and scale a leading platform used by hundreds of millions of consumers and millions of merchants for a wide range of transactions, from peer\-to\-peer transfers and bill payments to in\-store and online purchases. Beyond payments, we are expanding access to financial services, striving to make money management and financial products more accessible to all Indians. Joining our team means shaping the future of finance in one of the world's most dynamic digital economies.


Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead and own the end\-to\-end delivery of multiple complex, cross\-functional technical programs critical to Google Pay India's strategic goals, such as everyday utility payments (Billpay, Recharge, Transit), new feature launches, platform modernization, and partner ecosystem integrations.
* Define program scope, objectives, and key results (OKRs), translating ambiguous problems into clear plans, milestones, and deliverables.
* Drive program execution, proactively identify and mitigate risks, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Advocate the integration of agent\-based AI tools and autonomous workflows into technical program management practices, proactively automating routine operations and enhancing predictive risk mitigation.
* Exercise strong technical judgment to understand engineering challenges, contribute to design discussions, evaluate trade\-offs, and guide technical decisions.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

bc8310af.title: Senior Engagement Manager, Developer Transformation
bc8310af.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you ready to lead the AI\-driven transformation of how enterprise software teams build, ship, and scale? Do you combine deep technical credibility with strategic business acumen to drive measurable developer productivity outcomes at Fortune 500 companies? Can you operate independently in ambiguous environments — setting direction when strategy is unclear and turning undefined opportunities into quantifiable business impact?  

  

As a Senior Engagement Manager for Developer Transformation (DevTx), AWS India, you will own end\-to\-end strategy and execution of AI\-native developer transformation programs across India's largest enterprise customers. You will lead complex, multi\-stakeholder engagements where scope, ownership, and success criteria are often undefined — bringing clarity, setting direction, and driving documented business outcomes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering and business stakeholders, connecting developer AI adoption to measurable business value (productivity gains, time\-to\-market acceleration). You will build mechanisms that scale impact beyond individual engagements, shaping how AWS's developer transformation methodology is delivered across the APJ region.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the India AI\-DLC engagement pipeline — proactively identify, qualify, and prioritize developer transformation opportunities across ISVs, GSIs, FSI, and Enterprise segments by diving deep into customers' engineering organization structures, technology stacks, and business priorities. Define intake criteria and triage mechanisms that enable scale across the team. Convert undefined customer interest into scoped, investment\-justified engagement proposals with clear success metrics and ROI projections.
* Develop and articulate executive\-level narratives that connect developer transformation to business outcomes — productivity ROI, innovation velocity, and competitive differentiation. Tailor value propositions by industry vertical and customer maturity, and present independently to VP/CxO\-level engineering and business leaders.
* Lead cross\-functional delivery with Solutions Architects, Developer Specialist SAs, and field teams to design and execute AI\-native engineering transformation programs — including AI\-DLC workshops, and Kiro and developer tool adoption accelerators. Own engagement architecture and sequencing decisions. Resolve technical ambiguity by making informed trade\-offs.
* Own end\-to\-end engagement lifecycle — from qualification and scoping through delivery, measurement, and post\-engagement follow\-up — for complex enterprise developer transformation programs. Manage a portfolio of 8\-12 concurrent engagements across industries (FSI, manufacturing, technology, telecom), ensuring progress toward documented, measurable outcomes. Track and report pipeline metrics (ARR, opportunity conversion, engagement\-to\-launch ratio) with full accountability for India DevTx program targets.
* Design engagement governance structures — defining scope, success criteria, escalation paths, and exit criteria — in partnership with customer technical and business stakeholders. Evaluate feasibility, long\-term value realization potential, and AWS investment ROI before committing resources. Establish systems that ensure consistent engagement quality and eliminate non\-differentiated work through automation and reusable frameworks.
* Drive alignment across AWS internal teams (account managers, solutions architects, specialist teams) and customer organizations (engineering leadership, platform teams, developer communities). Navigate competing priorities and organizational politics to maintain momentum on transformation initiatives. Serve as the single thread connecting customer business outcomes to AWS technical delivery.
* Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior engineering leaders (VP/Director level) within customer organizations. Be recognized as the go\-to person for developer platform strategy and AI\-driven engineering transformation. Engage occasionally with C\-suite executives on strategic transformation vision and engagement decisions.
* Guide customers in designing their AI\-native software development operating models — from tool adoption (Kiro) through methodology transformation (AI\-DLC framework) to organizational change management. Ensure transformation initiatives deliver verified, quantified business outcomes within agreed timelines.
* Capture and systematize learnings from engagements into reusable assets (playbooks, case studies, enablement content) that multiply team effectiveness. Provide actionable customer feedback to AWS teams that informs DevTx charter and strategy. Contribute to thought leadership through internal blogs, external case studies, and conference presentations.
* Coordinate with APJ and Global DevTx peers on cross\-geography engagement opportunities, shared customer programs, and methodology standardization. Represent India DevTx in regional forums and contribute to scaling successful India engagement patterns across APJ.

  

What Makes This Role Unique  

  

This is not a traditional Engagement Manager or Professional Services role. In this role, you will:  

* Own programs, not projects — drive multi\-quarter customer transformation journeys, not time\-boxed billable engagements
* Combine strategy with execution — present transformation roadmaps to VPs of Engineering one day, then triage intake queues and unblock engagements the next
* Own business outcomes — be accountable for pipeline metrics, opportunity conversion, and ARR — not just engagement satisfaction scores

  

A day in the life  

Your days will be varied and high\-impact. One morning you might be reviewing a customer's AI\-DLC workshop feedback, refining the follow\-up plan that converts a successful prototype into a production adoption roadmap with clear revenue implications.  

  

Later that day, you could be presenting a transformation case to a customer's leadership team — articulating why their 5,000\-developer engineering org needs a structured AI\-native development program and what the expected business outcome looks like in 6 months.  

  

Between meetings, you'll triage new engagement requests in the intake queue — qualifying a GSI's ask for Kiro enablement, deprioritizing a low\-signal opportunity, and connecting an account team with the right specialist SA for a complex developer transformation scoping and review.  

  

You'll spend time building — creating reusable engagement frameworks, updating pipeline trackers, and authoring the narrative that justifies expanding DevTx's footprint into new customer segments. You'll collaborate with your global peers to exchange learnings, align on methodology standards, and identify customers with cross\-geography presence that need coordinated engagement strategies.  

  

This role requires balancing strategic executive engagement with operational program management — you'll shift between leadership conversations and intake triage daily.  

  

About the team  

The AWS Developer Transformation (DevTx) India team leads the next generation of software development practices across India's largest enterprises. We help engineering teams adopt AI\-native development methodologies and AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) transformations — compressing development timelines from months to days and weeks. Our team works directly with CTOs and VPs of Engineering to accelerate developer productivity at scale.  

  

We operate with high ownership, transparency, and autonomy — every team member owns their engagements from intake to outcome. This is a small, high\-impact team where your work directly shapes how major Indian enterprises build software.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of leading large\-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* 6\+ years of customer\-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
* Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
* Experience leading technical and non\-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle, including design, development, test, build, deployment processes and timelines
* PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
* Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
* Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
* Experience with AI/ML\-assisted development tools, developer productivity platforms, or DevOps/platform engineering transformation

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

d65a1c60.title: Technical Program Manager – Data Center Infrastructure Deployments
d65a1c60.description:
**About Nebius** 




  





 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure.
 



 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
 



 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of a defined workstream within large\-scale GPU and data center infrastructure deployment programs. In this role you’ll be responsible for tracking progress, managing dependencies, and ensuring your workstream is delivered on time and at quality.
 



 This is a hands\-on role at the intersection of infrastructure, execution, and coordination, with strong exposure to real\-world data center delivery.
 



 Travel: On\-site presence at data centers will be required during key deployment phases.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities Will Include** 




  




* Own delivery of a defined workstream within a larger data center or infrastructure program.
* Track scope, schedule, and dependencies, escalating risks when needed.
* Coordinate with engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting on progress, risks, and blockers.
* Support vendor and contractor coordination within your scope.
* Work closely with the Senior TPM to align on priorities and execution approach.



  





**Technical Scope \& Expectations** 




  





 This role requires exposure to physical infrastructure environments, not only software\-based projects.
 



  





**You Should Be Comfortable Working With Or Learning About** 




  




* Data center environments: basic understanding of infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, networking dependencies).
* Compute infrastructure: knowledge about server and storage equipment.
* Networking: cabling, connectivity, and integration dependencies.
* Deployment \& bring\-up: understanding how systems move from installation to operational readiness.



 You are not expected to be an expert, but you should:
 


* Be willing to learn technical concepts quickly.
* Understand how different parts of infrastructure depend on each other.
* Identify when something is not ready or at risk and escalate appropriately.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams.



  





**We Expect You To Have** 




  




* 2–5 years of experience in program management, operations, or technical coordination roles.
* Ability to organize work, track progress, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* communication skills and ability to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Structured thinking and attention to details.
* Willingness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced, technical environment.



  





**It will be an added bonus if you have** 




  




* Exposure to data center, networking, or hardware\-related projects,
* Familiarity with program management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.),
* Understanding of cloud environments infrastructure,
* Certifications or coursework in program management.



  





**Benefits \& Perks** 




  




* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams



  





**What's It Like To Work At Nebius** 




  





 Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 



 Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

**Job description**

Requisition ID: 1738802
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**EY GDS – APIGEE Platform Engineer Position**



Over the last decade, API\-led connectivity, cloud\-native modernization and digital transformation have become critical for ensuring scalability, security and resilience across enterprise ecosystems. To support this evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Google Apigee, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure and DevOps automation to deliver secure, high\-performance and highly available API management platforms for mission\-critical business applications.



As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Senior APIGEE Platform Architect supporting large\-scale API management environments across hybrid and multi\-cloud deployments.

  


**The Opportunity**



We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Google Apigee, Kubernetes, Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps Automation, API Security and Enterprise Architecture to deliver secure, scalable and highly available solutions for mission\-critical enterprise integrations and API ecosystems. This position provides opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders and support API modernization, cloud transformation and operational excellence initiatives.

  


**Your Key Responsibilities**


* Oversee Apigee platform architecture and implementation.
* Act as the primary escalation point for Apigee and platform issues.
* Design and support end\-to\-end platform migrations and modernization programs.
* Drive infrastructure automation, governance and security standards.
* Collaborate with networking, cloud, security and DevOps teams.
* Define HA, DR, scalability and resiliency requirements.
* Establish observability, monitoring and operational readiness standards.


**Strong Understanding Of:**


* Google Apigee platform administration and implementation, including proxies, shared flows, products, apps, environments, policies, analytics, and management APIs.
* Kubernetes operations including pods, deployments, services, ingress, namespaces, secrets, config maps, RBAC, autoscaling, logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, Azure, and hybrid/on\-prem environments.
* API Security concepts including OAuth2, JWT, API Keys, TLS/mTLS, rate limiting, quota, spike arrest, and threat protection.
* API Security concepts including OAuth2, JWT, TLS, and mTLS
* CI/CD and APIOps automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Maven, and scripting frameworks.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, and Ansible.
* Monitoring and Observability using Apigee Analytics, Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, and Splunk
* Linux administration, networking fundamentals, REST APIs, YAML/JSON, and production support operations.

  


**Skills and Attributes for Success**


* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Effective stakeholder and client management skills
* Strong architecture and technical documentation expertise
* Presentation and solution demonstration skills
* Team\-player mindset with collaborative working style
* Self\-motivated and proactive attitude
* Ability to lead architecture reviews and design workshops
* Experience driving Proof of Concepts (POCs) and innovation initiatives
* Strong decision\-making and technical leadership capabilities
* Ability to work across global and cross\-functional teams

  


**To Qualify for the Role, you must have**


* 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in API Management, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or DevOps
* Hands\-on experience with Google Apigee administration, deployment, and platform support.
* Experience working with Kubernetes platforms such as GKE, EKS, AKS, or enterprise Kubernetes distributions
* Experience implementing and supporting CI/CD and APIOps automation pipelines.
* Knowledge of cloud networking, DNS, load balancing, IAM, routing, and security controls.
* Experience with API Security implementation including OAuth2, JWT, TLS/mTLS, API Keys, and gateway policies.
* Strong Linux administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and production support experience.

  


**Additionally, Good to Have**


* Experience with Apigee Hybrid installation, upgrades, and runtime troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform, Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, or GitOps\-based platform provisioning
* IBM API Connect (APIC) and IBM DataPower migration experience
* Experience with DevSecOps and vulnerability scanning tools such as Trivy, Snyk, Checkov, tfsec, and SonarQube
* Experience in regulated, private cloud, multi\-cloud, or hybrid environments.
* Relevant certifications such as:
	+ Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
	+ Google Apigee API Engineer Certification
	+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  


**Ideally, You Will Also Have**


* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self\-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud\-based solutions for the company.

  


**What We Look For**


* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1000\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Chennai / Gurgaon / Pune

 Full\-time
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including C\-level executives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Solution Design \& Architecture:
+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
+ Analyze client requirements, existing IT landscapes, and business objectives to architect tailor\-made mainframe solutions, including on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid models.
+ Develop detailed architectural designs, high\-level designs, and associated documentation (e.g., application views, multiple sections \& views, artefacts).
+ Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate mainframe systems with the broader technology ecosystem.
+ Identify improvements, options, and tradeoffs to define target state solutions.

* Presales \& Client Engagement:
+ Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the presales phase, supporting the sales team in all technical aspects.

+ Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

+ Provide technical and strategic input for mainframe modernization strategies, including re\-hosting, refactoring, re\-platforming, and rewriting initiatives.
+ Guide customers in planning, evaluating, architecting, and re\-engineering legacy applications to leverage modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML for modernization), and best practices in mainframe and cloud landscapes.
+ Contribute to the development of white papers, case studies, and thought leadership content related to mainframe solutions and modernization.

+ Provide technical leadership to design, development, and implementation teams for custom solutions.
+ Mentor developers, designers, and junior architects, fostering their growth and enhancing their capabilities.

* Costing \& Risk Management:

+ Identify implementation risks and potential impacts, proposing mitigation strategies.
+ Validate solutions from a technology, cost structure, and customer differentiation perspective.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Typically 12\+ years of experience in a technology environment, with a strong focus on mainframe infrastructure solutions

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Willingness to travel as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**

**Job Description:**

 At Barry\-Wehmiller, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. We are a global provider of manufacturing technologies and services serving customers across packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and industrial automation markets.
   

  

 What sets us apart is our commitment to Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy centered on creating meaningful work, caring for people, and delivering business results through strong relationships and responsible leadership.

Teams across Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Content Management, IT, Sourcing, and Shared Services collaborate with global platforms to deliver innovative solutions and exceptional customer outcomes.

This role converts platform demand into executable work, develops engineering capability, and creates an environment where teams can consistently deliver high\-quality outcomes.

Do you combine deep technical credibility with strategic business acumen to drive measurable developer productivity outcomes at Fortune 500 companies? Can you operate independently in ambiguous environments — setting direction when strategy is unclear and turning undefined opportunities into quantifiable business impact?
   

  

 As a Senior Engagement Manager for Developer Transformation (DevTx), AWS India, you will own end\-to\-end strategy and execution of AI\-native developer transformation programs across India's largest enterprise customers. You will lead complex, multi\-stakeholder engagements where scope, ownership, and success criteria are often undefined — bringing clarity, setting direction, and driving documented business outcomes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering and business stakeholders, connecting developer AI adoption to measurable business value (productivity gains, time\-to\-market acceleration). You will build mechanisms that scale impact beyond individual engagements, shaping how AWS's developer transformation methodology is delivered across the APJ region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the India AI\-DLC engagement pipeline — proactively identify, qualify, and prioritize developer transformation opportunities across ISVs, GSIs, FSI, and Enterprise segments by diving deep into customers' engineering organization structures, technology stacks, and business priorities. Define intake criteria and triage mechanisms that enable scale across the team. Convert undefined customer interest into scoped, investment\-justified engagement proposals with clear success metrics and ROI projections.
* Develop and articulate executive\-level narratives that connect developer transformation to business outcomes — productivity ROI, innovation velocity, and competitive differentiation. e0d31073.title: Solutions Engineer
e0d31073.description:
**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both** 



  


 A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 


  


**What the week contains** 



  


 Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.
 


  


**The uncomfortable part** 



  


 Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.
 


  


**Looking for** 



  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales engineering or a customer\-facing technical role
* Enough hands\-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience


  


 Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.
 


  


*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer\-facing engineering roles here.*

bed842a1.title: Lead System Architect & Technical Program Manager
bed842a1.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We are seeking a visionary and execution\-oriented **Lead System Architect \& Technical Program Manager (TPM)** to lead the execution of our high\-priority, large\-scale technical initiatives for the CitiDirect Platform Core and Platform Digital Servicing Agile Release Trains (ARTs). This is a unique, hybrid role designed for a senior technical leader who can both design complex, enterprise\-grade system architectures and actively drive their execution across both ARTs.


In this role, your primary focus will be **System Architecture**—defining the technical vision, designing scalable system architectures, and building the architectural runway. Concurrently, you will leverage **Technical Program Management** competencies to operationalize your designs, manage cross\-team technical dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure the successful delivery of high\-priority technical initiatives.


You will serve as the ultimate technical authority for the CitiDirect Platform ARTs, bridging the gap between high\-level enterprise strategy and hands\-on engineering execution.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**1\. System Architecture \& Technical Strategy (Primary Focus \- 70%)**
------------------------------------------------------------------------


* **Architectural Vision \& Design:** Define and communicate the future\-state architecture, technical vision, and system design patterns for the platforms within the Platform ARTs.
* **Architectural Runway:** Design and champion **Enabler Epics and Features** (covering cloud infrastructure, microservices, security, and data architecture) to ensure the platform supports near\-term business features without technical debt.
* **Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs):** Define, monitor, and enforce NFRs—including security, scalability, high availability, performance, and maintainability—across the ART scrum teams.
* **Technical Debt \& Modernization:** Identify systemic technical debt, prioritize remediation efforts, and lead architectural spikes or prototyping for new technology evaluations.
* **Engineering Standards:** Establish and promote modern engineering practices, including DevSecOps, Test\-Driven Development (TDD), automated testing, and API\-first design patterns.

**2\. Technical Program Management \& Execution (30%)**
-------------------------------------------------------


* **Program Delivery Coordination:** Partner with the Release Train Engineer (RTE) to facilitate PI (Program Increment) execution, ensuring that engineering teams deliver on technical milestones and architectural enablers.
* **Dependency \& Risk Management:** Proactively identify, map, and resolve complex technical dependencies across multiple partner ARTs.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Lead the identification of program\-level technical risks and systematically address them through stakeholder engagement – product, architecture and engineering.
* **Backlog Prioritization:** Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners (POs) to refine the Program Backlog to ensure epics/tasks are always available for upcoming PIs.
* **Technical Translation:** Translate complex architectural designs, non\-functional requirements (NFRs), and security mandates into clear, actionable features and user stories for engineering teams.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide transparent, data\-driven status updates, technical risk assessments, and delivery metrics to senior leadership and stakeholders.

**Key SAFe Ceremony Involvements**
==================================


* **PI Planning:** Present the Architectural Vision and technical context to the ART; facilitate technical breakout sessions to validate team\-level designs, map dependencies on the Program Board, and draft technical PI objectives.
* **ART Sync / Scrum of Scrums:** Act as the primary technical escalation point to resolve architectural blockers, infrastructure issues, and cross\-team dependencies.
* **System Demo:** Lead the evaluation of the integrated system demo to ensure architectural integrity, interoperability, and NFR compliance.
* **Inspect \& Adapt (I\&A):** Lead problem\-solving workshops to address systemic technical, architectural, or infrastructure bottlenecks identified during the PI.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================


**Required:**
-------------


* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* **Experience:**
	+ 7\+ years of experience in software engineering, system design, and enterprise\-scale architecture.
	+ Deep, hands\-on experience working within a **Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)** environment.
* **Technical Depth:**
	+ Proven expertise in designing and deploying cloud\-native architectures (ECS, AWS), microservices, and event\-driven systems.
	+ Strong understanding of DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Kubernetes/Docker), and modern data architectures.

**Preferred Certifications:**
-----------------------------


* **Architecture:** SAFe® System Architect (ARCH), AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* **Agile/Program Management:** SAFe® Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM), SAFe® Release Train Engineer (RTE), or Project Management Professional (PMP).

**Core Competencies**
=====================


* **Architectural/Technical Authority:** Strong technical credibility to guide, mentor, and gain the respect of senior engineers, tech leads, and system architects.
* **Strategic Execution:** Exceptional ability to translate abstract architectural concepts into concrete, phased execution plans.
* **Influence \& Collaboration:** Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority.

**Systemic Problem Solving:** A track record of diagnosing and resolving complex, systemic technical blockers across highly matrixed organizations.


\-

---------------------

--------------

------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.

Strong understanding of planning algorithms (constrained/unconstrained), pegging, and network optimization. Scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) skill is a must. 95704d65.title: Staff Solutions Architect - AI/ML
95704d65.description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 




  


**Your New Role**
**:**
  
 



 As the
 **Staff, Solutions Architect (AI/ML)** 
 , you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of AI and Machine Learning solutions within one of the world’s largest Media \& Entertainment companies. Based in India, you will lead the design and implementation of innovative AI/ML architectures that transform how we create, distribute, and monetize content across global markets.
 







 Your expertise will help bridge the gap between complex business challenges and advanced technical solutions, ensuring AI initiatives deliver real business value. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of creativity and technology, where you’ll lead the development of intelligent solutions for personalized viewer experiences, optimized content workflows, and data\-driven decision\-making.
 







 If you’re passionate about leveraging AI/ML to revolutionize the Media \& Entertainment industry and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment, this role is for you.
 







  


**1\. AI/ML Solution Design and Development** 



* Design and develop scalable AI/ML solutions tailored to address business challenges such as audience analytics, content personalization, and ad optimization.
* Lead the end\-to\-end architecture of AI/ML platforms, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and data pipelines.
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to convert models into production\-ready solutions.
* Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML frameworks, technologies, and tools to meet project requirements.
* Ensure AI solutions are optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability across diverse use cases.



  


**2\. Technical Leadership and Innovation** 



* Provide technical leadership for AI/ML projects, guiding teams through solution architecture, development, and deployment.
* Stay abreast of emerging AI/ML trends and technologies to introduce innovative solutions and best practices.
* Lead proof\-of\-concept (POC) initiatives to validate new AI capabilities and demonstrate their potential impact.
* Promote a culture of innovation within the team, encouraging experimentation with cutting\-edge AI/ML techniques.
* Mentor junior architects and engineers to build a strong pipeline of AI/ML talent.



  


**3\. Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Act as a key interface between business units, technical teams, and senior leadership to align AI/ML solutions with organizational goals.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications, ensuring clarity and feasibility.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to prioritize and execute AI/ML projects that deliver the highest business impact.
* Communicate the value and progress of AI/ML initiatives to non\-technical stakeholders through clear, compelling narratives.
* Foster strong relationships with external partners, including technology vendors and academic institutions, to drive innovation.



  


**4\. AI Governance and Risk Management** 



* Implement best practices for AI/ML governance, including model explainability, accountability, and ethical use.
* Ensure AI solutions comply with data privacy regulations and internal security protocols.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with AI/ML implementations, such as bias, overfitting, or data quality issues.
* Develop monitoring frameworks to track model performance and retrain models as necessary to maintain effectiveness.
* Establish guidelines and documentation for AI/ML processes, ensuring consistency and transparency.



  


**5\. Scalability and Continuous Improvement** 



* Architect solutions that are modular and scalable, capable of supporting future business growth and technological evolution.
* Regularly review and optimize existing AI/ML systems for improved performance and cost\-efficiency.
* Establish feedback loops to capture learnings from deployed solutions and inform future enhancements.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency using AI/ML.
* Lead initiatives to streamline workflows and reduce time\-to\-market for AI/ML projects.







  


**Qualifications \& Experiences:**




  


**Academic Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline.
* Specialized certifications in AI/ML (e.g., Google Cloud AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning Specialty) are a plus.



  


**Professional Experience:** 



* **8\+ years** 
  of experience in AI/ML solution architecture, with at least 
 **3\+ years** 
  in a leadership role.
* Proven track record of designing and deploying AI/ML solutions in enterprise\-scale environments, preferably within Media \& Entertainment or a similar industry.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Strong expertise in building and optimizing data pipelines, model deployment workflows, and MLOps practices.
* Experience in implementing AI use cases like recommendation systems, natural language processing (NLP), and computer vision.



  


**Technical Skills:** 



* Proficiency in programming languages like Python, Java, or R.
* Expertise in big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and database systems (SQL, NoSQL).
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture and APIs for AI model integration.
* Advanced knowledge of AI model lifecycle management, from training to deployment and monitoring.
* Familiarity with visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to present AI\-driven insights.



  


**Soft Skills:** 



* Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking abilities.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.
* Leadership qualities, including mentoring and team development.
* High adaptability to a fast\-paced and dynamic work environment.



















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
 









 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
 
 accessibility page
 
 for instructions to submit your request.

The ideal candidate is hands\-on, customer\-focused, and passionate about cloud technologies, automation, and cybersecurity.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Serve as a cloud security subject matter expert for customers and InviGrid engineering teams.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to build the InviGrid solution for provisioning, deployments, security controls, monitoring, cost optimizations, remediations, re\-architecting, and compliance processes.
* Research emerging cloud and security technologies. Stay abreast of latest in cloud, in security and automation technologies.

* Support SOC2 and other audits and customer security questionnaires.

**Required Certification (Any One)** 



* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert

**What We're Looking For** 



* Hungry for knowledge, always staying abreast of cloud, security and automation.

793b3006.title: Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Architecture
793b3006.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, systems design, corporate IT, technical program management, or business process engineering.
* Experience organizing review pipelines, managing technical project queues, and facilitating cross\-team technical alignment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to read complex integration diagrams, map system dependencies, and systematically spot application redundancies.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills to collaborate seamlessly with globally spread partners and influence distributed developer teams.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the continuous improvement and meticulous hygiene of our centralized architecture repository (powered by LeanIX). Ensure application metadata, system capabilities, and cross\-pillar integration flows are mapped and documented with the highest standards of accuracy to serve as a reliable global source of truth.
* Partner with globally spread product, engineering, and architecture teams across corporate engineering domains to drive alignment, foster collaboration, and help teams adopt enterprise standards, enabling faster delivery and standard practices globally.
* Assist in defining, establishing, and maintaining core architectural foundations. This includes helping build and curate the EA Toolkit of approved reference architectures, reusable design patterns, standard guidelines, and approved technologies to drive consistency.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

17d83618.title: Senior Program Manager, TSE Product
17d83618.description:
**Description**
 Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent fraud among hundreds of millions of e\-Commerce transactions in different countries? What would you do to create a trusted marketplace where millions of buyers and sellers can safely transact online? What kinds of processes and systems would you build to maximize customer satisfaction? Come be a part of a rapidly expanding Trustworthy Shopping Experience Operations (TSE Ops) team that helps solve this challenging problem at scale.
   

  

 The Team: The Trustworthy Shopping Experience Operations (TSE Ops) works on improving seller experience and overall ensuring that Amazon’s marketplace is a safe and trusted space for our customers by enabling activities in different scopes, such as: Product Safety and Compliance (PSC), Restricted Products (RP), Product Quality (PQ) and Trusted Order and Remediation Experience (TORX). In addition to these, the team has support functions which enable the investigator and operational experience through workforce and capacity planning, ops analytics, site strategy, program expansion, change management, tech enablement and security and compliance. The team supports 16 languages across 21 Amazon stores with over 8K employees located in 17 sites.
   

  

 Role : We are looking for a Sr Program Manager to support the Trust worthy Shopping experience (TSE) Operations \& Product team. The role holder will look at opportunities within the TSE space that can be unified and done centrally, thereby helping deliver cost savings. The role holder will need to partner with program teams to understand their needs and evaluate opportunities for standardization and automation. And partner with Operations team for seamless execution.
   

  

 The right candidate is highly organized, can look out for potential opportunities, earn trust with partner teams and also have a tech bent of mind for automation. Also the role holder is required to have the ability to evangelize the idea to multiple partner teams, have a strong ability to communicate effectively (both orally and in written form) and have experience influencing without authority. You are a strategic thinker with a proven track record of taking end\-to\-end ownership, planning both for the short\-and long term, and successfully delivering results with limited guidance.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Drive SOP standardization by partnering with Program stakeholders.
* Evaluate and drive opportunities to drive SOP automation to improve speed and accuracy of the investigators.
* Ensure that the Ops investigators have a seamless experience across functions, working with product and tech teams to own and fix workflow issues.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 5\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 9ee0cfa8.title: Program Manager – AI Transformation & Change
9ee0cfa8.description:
⚡We are your
 **Energy Technology Partner** 
 . We electrify, automate, and digitalize every industry, business, and home, driving efficiency and sustainability for all.
   

  

 At Schneider Electric, our values – IMPACT (Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork) – are the foundation of everything we do. Becoming an Impact Maker means turning sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization.
   

  

 Are you ready to lead the digital transformation to create a more sustainable world?🌳
   

  

 If you are up to challenge your creativity and make an impact, we are excited to welcome you!
   

  

**Schneider Digital** 
 is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by \+450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.
   

  

 DCR is the digital backbone of Schneider Electric, representing \~1,200 FTEs and FTCs across eight capability domains. As AI is projected to reshape every DCR role, The DCR AI Operations team has been established to stand up a governed programme that turns the AI vision into measurable delivery across all DCR capabilities.
   

  

 Phase 2 of the programme (H2 2026\) focuses on building the foundation: establishing governance structures, validating priority use cases through live pilots, and preparing the organisation for full\-scale deployment in Phase 3\. The Transformation \& Change stream is the backbone of this phase — responsible for programme governance, use case portfolio management, process reinvention, and capability upskilling across all domains.
   

  

 In this context, the
 **Program Manager** 
 is the operational lead of the Transformation stream and the central orchestrator of the overall programme, translating strategic intent into a governed and deliverable roadmap.
   

  

**What will you do?**
**Key Responsibilities**
 The Program Manager leads the Transformation stream and orchestrates the end\-to\-end programme.
   

  

 Scope: Transformation \& Change \| Value Realization \| Solution Design \| AI Delivery
   

  

* Set up the programme operating model \& governance – Programme leadership role
* Define the end\-to\-end programme operating model: roles, decision rights, RACI matrix, and organisational design.
* Establish and chair the governance cadence, from operational syncs to executive steering committees, ensuring appropriate escalation paths and decision clarity.
* Define programme\-level KPIs aligned to the value framework; drive delivery against H2 2026 milestones (operating model set\-up, pilot selection, reinvention vision, upskilling strategy).
* Coordinate the AI use case portfolio \& stakeholder alignment – Orchestration role
* Lead the review and prioritisation of the AI use case portfolio with the AI Hub, scoring and shortlisting the highest\-value cases from the 120\-case inventory.
* Manage cross\-functional interdependencies across all workstreams, proactively resolving conflicts, blockers, and resource constraints before they impact delivery.
* Build trusted relationships with DCR domain SPOCs, BU VPs, and capability leaders; act as the communication bridge between programme execution and executive leadership.
* Drive programme delivery \& enable pilot execution – Execution management role
* Oversee the delivery plan across Foundation Setup (Q3 2026\), Pilot Validation (Q4 2026–Q1 2027\), and Deployment Readiness at scale (2027\+).
* Coordinate end\-to\-end pilot execution across all workstreams, from scoping through results capture and lessons\-learned consolidation into Phase 3 playbooks.
* Activate staffing for priority open roles; lead the development of operating model documentation, decision frameworks, and reusable playbooks for Phase 3 scaling.


**What qualifications will make you successful?**
**Qualifications:**
* Business or Engineering Degree
* 10\+ years in Programme/Project Management, Digital Transformation, or Technology Consulting
* Demonstrated track record of setting up and running complex, multi\-workstream programmes in a large, matrixed organisation
* Experience in AI, automation, or digital platform adoption programmes is strongly preferred
* Strong familiarity with governance frameworks, organisational design, and change management principles
* Ability to operate across multiple levels — from programme strategy to hands\-on delivery coordination — in a fast\-moving environment
* Multicultural, international environment experience strongly preferred


**Skills:**
* Strategic vision and executive\-level storytelling
* Governance and operating model design
* Structured problem\-solving with analytical rigour
* Risk management, conflict resolution, and decision facilitation
* Fluent in English; additional languages a plus


**What will you get?**
 We adapt to you:
   

  

 🕓 With our flexible schedule, you'll have the freedom to adjust your work hours to accommodate your personal needs and responsibilities.
   

  

 💻 We know how great it is to work from home. With our hybrid work plan, you can enjoy working from the comfort of your home.
   

  

 🏝 Need more time to relax and disconnect? With our Holy Pack, you can purchase additional vacation days to recharge when you need it most.
   

  

 📅 Celebrate holidays your way! With Floating Holidays, you can exchange holidays for other days that better suit your plans and personal preferences.
   

  

 🧘‍Need additional time to explore new experiences or focus on personal projects? With the Sabbatical Pack, you can request up to 2 months of extra leave (unpaid).
   

  

 💞 We value the importance of family and want to support you in all aspects of your life. Our Global Family Leave Policy provides flexible paid conditions for when you need it most, whether you're about to be a parent, need time to overcome a loss, or to care for a loved one.
   

  

 We take care of you:
   

  

 📱 With access to the health and wellness platform Wellwo, you and up to 5 people of your choice can enjoy access to wellness content, nutrition counseling, fitness classes, and more!
   

  

 🏄‍From dance classes to booking a hotel spa, we offer an agreement with Wellhub so you can access a network of thousands of gyms and sports centers to keep your body active in the way you like best.
   

  

 🩺 Your well\-being is our priority. You will have medical service at your workplace for close attention to any medical needs.
   

  

 We empower you:
   

  

 🎯 With Career Hub, our AI\-driven professional development platform, you can connect with job opportunities, projects, and mentors at Schneider Electric globally.
   

  

 🤑 We offer you the opportunity to be a shareholder of Schneider Electric and share in our achievements with our stock ownership program.
   

  

 🙌 We celebrate everyone's talent and success with our recognition program, through which you can give and receive points for your achievements and redeem them for gift cards at your favorite stores.
   

  

 💗 You will have life insurance for your protection.
   

  

 💰 We offer you a Flexible Remuneration Plan in which you can choose from a variety of options, such as health insurance, meal vouchers, childcare vouchers, transportation vouchers, training, and more.
   

  

 🎁 With Club Schneider, you will enjoy special discounts at your favorite stores, restaurants, travel agencies, and other external services.
   

  

 💚 Participate in company\-subsidized volunteer programs to contribute to our community and have a positive impact on your environment.
   

  

 Bring your expertise to a team that's ready to achieve great things together — apply today!

* ServiceNow SOM/SOMT, TSM, TNI, ITSM, CSM, FSM, CMDB/CSDM, integrations
* Telecom OSS/BSS integration experience.
* Performance Analytics, Now Assist, AI Agents, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Minimum two (2\) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications.
* 8\+ years of ServiceNow experience, including architecture, development, and integration delivery.
* Strong hands\-on scripting experience in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub.

* Exposure to ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, and release management
* Experience in stakeholder management and client\-facing roles
* Knowledge of ServiceNow’s latest features and roadmap

* A team player and Leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem\-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start\-ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You’ll quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of a collaborative environment focused on quality and innovation.

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced professionals
* Opportunities to develop new skills and grow your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
