620fedf2.title: Senior Staff Solution Architect
620fedf2.description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

 Sr Staff Solutions Architect (Design Partner Program)
   

  

 The Challenge
   

  

 We're looking for a Solutions Architect to join our R\&D Customer Engineering organisation and partner with strategic Design Partner customers. This is a highly customer\-facing role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, product strategy, and enterprise governance.
   

  

 You will work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, technical requirements, regulatory considerations, and strategic objectives. Acting as the bridge between customers, Product Management, Engineering, and Executive Leadership, you will help shape product direction, influence roadmap investments, and design scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer outcomes.
   

  

 Success in this role means helping customers operationalise trust, governance, privacy, risk management, consent, and responsible data use while accelerating adoption, improving implementation outcomes, and driving long\-term platform value.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand business objectives, technical requirements, operational challenges, and strategic priorities.
* Lead discovery workshops, architecture reviews, solution assessments, and technical design sessions.
* Translate customer needs into scalable solution architectures, implementation strategies, and reusable design patterns.
* Bridge customer requirements with Product Management and Engineering teams by identifying product gaps, influencing roadmap priorities, and driving platform improvements.
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise solutions across workflows, integrations, APIs, data models, governance processes, and operational architectures.
* Drive measurable customer outcomes through successful adoption, implementation quality, operational efficiency, governance maturity, and long\-term platform value.
* Create reference architectures, best practices, implementation standards, and reusable solution patterns that improve customer success and scalability.


**You Are**
* A customer\-facing technical leader who operates at the intersection of solution architecture, business strategy, and enterprise technology.
* Comfortable engaging with executives, architects, engineers, product leaders, privacy, risk, compliance, security, governance, identity, marketing, and business stakeholders.
* Able to translate complex technical concepts, architecture decisions, and regulatory requirements into clear business outcomes.
* A systems thinker who designs for scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, and long\-term platform success.
* Influential without direct authority and effective at driving alignment across cross\-functional teams.


**Your Experience Includes**
* 10\+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Solutions Consulting, Technical Product Leadership, Customer Engineering, or similar customer\-facing technical roles within enterprise SaaS organisations.
* Proven experience working directly with enterprise customers to gather requirements, lead discovery, shape technical strategy, design solutions, and drive adoption.
* Strong solution architecture experience, including APIs, integrations, workflow design, data models, enterprise platforms, governance controls, security, and scalable implementation patterns.
* Experience partnering with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence product direction and solve complex customer challenges.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Experience designing reusable frameworks, reference architectures, implementation patterns, best practices, and solution standards.


 Domain Experience
   

  

 Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:
 **Privacy, Risk \& Governance, Compliance, Security Governance, Data Governance, Consent \& Preference Management, Identity, MarTech, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or related enterprise SaaS domains.**
 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data
   

  

 You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
   

  

 Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
   

  

**Our Commitment to You**
 When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
   

  

 OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

ac7e9936.title: Sr Technical Consultant - Azure Cloud, DevOps, Sql & Site Reliability Engineering(SRE)
ac7e9936.description:
**Overview**
* The BYX Platform provides shared cloud provisioning, compute, storage, observability and runtime capabilities for enterprise applications and implementation teams.
* We are seeking an astute Cloud Platform with a strong technical foundation and hands\-on experience in Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, containers, observability, networking and production automation.


**Our Current Technical Environment**
* Cloud and Compute: Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, node pools, container workloads, Azure Container Registry, KEDA, Dask, autoscaling, CPU, memory and GPU capacity.
* Observability: Logs, metrics and traces; collectors and exporters; Elastic/Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, dashboards, alerts and correlation identifiers.
* Data and Storage: MongoDB/Atlas, SQL, Redis, NFS, managed storage, replicas, regional capacity and service quotas.
* Networking and Security: DNS, CIDR, private endpoints, firewall rules, allowlists, TLS/certificates, SPNs, API keys, tokens, image\-pull credentials and Git\-hosted secrets.
* Operations and Automation: Linux, Git, CI/CD deployment workflows, infrastructure automation and scripting using Bash, Python or PowerShell.


**What You’ll Do**
* Review and act on incidents, service requests, infrastructure requests and provisioning failures logged by implementation teams and platform users.
* Own L2/L3 cloud\-platform issues from initial triage through recovery, validation, communication, root\-cause analysis and closure.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes pods, deployments, replicas, services, events, health checks, node pools, scheduling and resource constraints.
* Diagnose container image\-pull, startup, shutdown, registry\-authentication, rollout and workload\-reconciliation failures.
* Investigate CPU, memory, GPU, quota, region, placement and capacity issues affecting platform workloads.
* Troubleshoot workload and event\-driven autoscaling using Kubernetes metrics and technologies such as KEDA.
* Support Azure resource provisioning, provider operations, resource lifecycle workflows and reconciliation between desired and actual state.
* Diagnose ACR, private endpoint, firewall, allowlist, CIDR, DNS, TLS and runtime\-connectivity problems.
* Trace logs, metrics and distributed telemetry from the workload through collectors, exporters and observability ingestion pipelines.
* Support Elastic/Logstash/Kibana ingestion, index mappings, access, dashboards, alerts and environment filters.
* Investigate operational issues involving MongoDB/Atlas, SQL, Redis, NFS and related managed data or storage services.
* Support certificates, service principals, API keys, image\-pull credentials and infrastructure credential rotation.
* Support regional releases, environment configuration, disaster\-recovery workflows and post\-deployment validation.
* Develop automation to improve platform reliability, reduce manual provisioning and shorten incident recovery time.
* Maintain runbooks, dashboards, alerts, known\-error records and diagnostic procedures for use by platform support teams.
* Participate in capacity planning, incident reviews, change reviews, release readiness and an agreed production on\-call rotation.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Minimum 5\-10 years of relevant work experience in Azure cloud infrastructure, DevOps, site reliability engineering or platform operations.
* This role includes Rotational Shifts(Night shifts of 2 months in Year)
* Hands\-on production experience with Microsoft Azure services and operational troubleshooting
* Strong Kubernetes troubleshooting skills covering workloads, events, services, networking, scheduling, scaling and resource management.
* Experience with a container registry; Azure Container Registry experience is highly relevant.
* Practical observability experience across logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alerts.
* Experience with Elastic Stack components—Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana—or a closely comparable platform.
* Working knowledge of DNS, TLS/certificates, CIDR, firewalls, proxies, load balancing and private networking.
* Strong Linux administration, application log analysis and production incident\-troubleshooting skills.
* Scripting experience with Bash, Python or PowerShell for diagnostics and operational automation.
* Experience troubleshooting CI/CD deployments, configuration changes and failed rollouts.
* Working knowledge of Git, service identities and secrets\-management fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of MongoDB/Atlas, Redis, SQL or NFS operations is preferred.
* Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, Bicep or ARM templates and Kubernetes packaging such as Helm is preferred.
* Experience with incident response, Root Cause Analysis, post\-incident reviews and controlled production changes.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across application, security, networking and vendor teams.
* Willingness to participate in a scheduled production on\-call rotation and planned out\-of\-hours changes when required.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

84229614.title: Technical Program Manager
84229614.description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You'll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. You'll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why we're building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on IC role and you'll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working\-hour overlap with our Asia\-based Tech Team.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.


**What You’ll Own**
* Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.
* Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross\-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.
* Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.
* Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.
* Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.
* Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow\-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* At least 3\+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.
* A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross\-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data\-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.
* Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.
* Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.
* First\-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.
* Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process aren't fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.
* Strong cross\-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer\-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.
* High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.
* Startup mindset: You enjoy working in a lean environment where there isn't a dedicated person for every function. You're willing to get into the details, solve problems yourself, and build lightweight processes when they are genuinely useful.


**What’s In It For You**
* Own a high\-leverage problem: You'll be the person responsible for keeping delivery moving across teams, directly influencing how quickly and reliably we turn product ideas into something customers can use.
* Work at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, and Logistics: Our products combine software, data, machine learning, and deep logistics expertise. You'll get exposure to complex product problems where the challenge isn't simply building software, but making sure data, models, workflows, and customer needs come together.
* Real impact from day one: we’re lean by design so you'll have a high degree of ownership. There is no large PMO or layer of project managers around you. You'll need to be comfortable getting into the details, figuring things out independently, and knowing when something needs to be pushed, clarified, escalated, or simply solved.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO**
* Curiosity: We dig into why something's slipping, not just how to patch it. We stay close to the work and the data.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We hold a project together end to end and stay on it until it ships cleanly.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for "it launched." We aim for delivery that's predictable, aligned, and free of last\-minute surprises.
* Effective: We focus on shipping what was actually intended, on time, with real impact, not process for its own sake.


 Join us at Portcast in our vision to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

f2273172.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon
f2273172.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Grocery Catalog and Supplier org is looking for a passionate and innovative Sr Technical Program Manager to join our Catalog team. This team will be deployed against some of our most complex and challenging projects and will deliver innovative technical solutions. We have an opportunity to revolutionize on\-line shopping and set new standards for accessing the highest quality organic and natural groceries on\-online.  

  

As the Sr TPM, you will be a key member of tech leadership and will need to drive forward the technology across catalog system to create a best in class online grocery shopping experience.  

We are looking for a Sr Technical Program Manager (TPM) with business and technical skills, great communication abilities, and a passion to use cutting edge science and technologies to help WFM.  

  

Our team is seeking Sr Technical Program Managers to manage large, cross functional programs and projects that support catalog business. In this role you will be responsible for delivering large projects end\-to\-end that span multiple technology and operational teams. These projects will include initiatives such as rolling out new technology to new geographies as we expand, creating new technology to support new businesses and use cases, and otherwise building great technology platforms that can scale. In this role, you will lead large\-scale re\-architecture of our technology stack across multiple systems and teams. You will lead and coordinate design/implementation efforts, coordinating across multiple teams to develop optimal solutions. You will be expected to make appropriate tradeoffs to optimize time\-to\-market, clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross\-functional and remote project teams.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This role is inherently cross\-functional—this leader will work closely with engineering, project management, design, operations, finance, legal, business development, customer service, and executive teams to bring products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our existing products and features. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer\-focused, team oriented, and will have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. The leader will have a proven track record in taking on end\-to\-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment. As a Sr TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 8\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing technical programs across cross\-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------


\- \- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules  

\- \- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership  

\- \- Experience driving multiple products through a complete lifecycle  

\- \- High Scale services experience  

\- \- Experience combining hardware \& software development  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

f6ae838a.title: Program Manager II, Buyer Abuse
f6ae838a.description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Buyer Abuse Prevention (BAP) team sits within the broader Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) organization — a centralized technology and program team whose mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Buyer abuse is defined as the risk associated with customers repeatedly violating Amazon's policies and affecting the profitability, brand, and reputation of Amazon or its Selling Partners.
   

  

 BAP sits at the intersection of technology, policy, and operations to detect, investigate, and prevent abusive behaviors across Amazon. Our work directly impacts Amazon's bottom line, protecting hundreds of millions of dollars in concession losses annually while preserving the customer and seller experience.
   

  

 BAP is seeking an innovative, results\-oriented, and customer\-centric Program Manager to own and drive the Automation program across the Buyer Abuse Prevention organization. In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Amazon's ability to investigate and act on risky orders and concessions at billions\-of\-transactions scale — without relying on manual effort. You will define the automation strategy, manage a portfolio of automation initiatives, and balance the dual mandate of maximizing automation rate while carefully managing enforcement quality through leakage (under\-enforcement) and customer experience (over\-enforcement) metrics.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer focused, team oriented, and have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. He or she will have a proven track record in taking on end\-to\-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end Automation program strategy, roadmap, and execution across BAP, including setting goals, success metrics, and mechanisms to track progress against automation rate targets.
* Balance the core automation tradeoff: maximizing automation rate while managing leakage (under\-enforcement risk) and customer experience metrics (over\-enforcement risk), ensuring precision thresholds are maintained across all deployed models and workflows.
* Define and manage key success metrics for the Automation program, including automation rate, task coverage, precision, leakage rate, false positive rate, and customer\-facing impact metrics.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, and Data Science teams to design, test, and launch new automation capabilities — including LLM\-powered enforcement, model\-based auto\-decisions, and workflow automation.
* Interact with key stakeholders to define the metrics, measurements, and tools to quantify automation program goals and communicate results to Senior Leaders across Amazon.
* Conduct in\-depth reviews of automation performance data to identify patterns, gaps, and opportunities; develop reports and narratives for leadership and partner teams.
* Communicate (both verbally and in writing) program successes, failures, lessons learned, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Champion on behalf of Amazon and our Customers and help uncover issues currently impacting our Customer Experience as a result of automation decisions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

* Automation \& Cloud Infrastructure Proficiency: Demonstrated skill in authoring automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Shell) to integrate storage environments, automate migrations, and orchestrate hybrid\-cloud infrastructures (AWS, Azure, VMware).
* Consultative \& Technical Leadership: Strong pre\-sales and post\-sales advisory capabilities, with proven ability to manage project scope, mitigate delivery risks, and effectively articulate complex technical solutions to enterprise stakeholders.

ea110ffd.title: ServiceNow Platform Architect
ea110ffd.description:
**We’re Hiring \| ServiceNow Platform Architect \| Remote**

Are you an experienced **ServiceNow Platform Architect** ?

The candidate should have 12\+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 8 years of hands\-on ServiceNow experience and experience delivering a minimum of two end\-to\-end ServiceNow platform implementations.

**Role:**ServiceNow Platform Architect  
**Location:** Remote  
**Experience:** 12\+ Years  
Salary**:** Up to ₹1\.2 lakh per Month

Role Summary

The ServiceNow Platform Architect will be responsible for architecting, designing, and implementing ServiceNow solutions at an enterprise scale. The role will provide technical leadership across multiple agile delivery teams and ensure that the platform is designed in alignment with CSDM v5, ITIL best practices, and ServiceNow Zurich release capabilities, with a strong focus on scalability, automation, upgradeability, and maximum adoption of out\-of\-the\-box capabilities. The role will involve close collaboration with business stakeholders, SMEs, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and development teams to build a cohesive ServiceNow ecosystem across ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, automation, governance, and enterprise planning.

Key Responsibilities

● The candidate will define and own the end\-to\-end ServiceNow platform architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and upgradeability, and will act as the technical authority across multiple ServiceNow implementations and agile teams. The role will involve making architectural decisions aligned with ServiceNow best practices and CSDM v5 while promoting minimal customization and maximum use of out\-of\-the\-box features, workflows, and AI\-driven capabilities.

● The candidate will architect and implement ServiceNow modules including CMDB and CSDM v5, Service Catalogue, ITSM Pro\+, Now Assist, Virtual Agents, ITOM, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, Workflow Data Fabric, Integration Hub, and IRM/GRC. The role will also involve driving automation\-first solutions using Flow Designer, Integration Hub, RPA Hub, Now Assist agents, and AI/ML capabilities.

● The candidate will lead CMDB and Discovery architecture, including CI classes, relationships, data quality, reconciliation, governance, service models, business services, and application services. They will also define CMDB health metrics, audit mechanisms, and continuous improvement processes while applying ITIL best practices across Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset, and Service Portfolio Management.

● The role will also require experience designing and overseeing integrations between ServiceNow and on\-premise applications, cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP, and enterprise tools across monitoring, security, finance, HR, and ERP. Strong knowledge of Integration Hub, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, event\-driven integration patterns, Python, Now Assist, Virtual Agents, and RPA Hub is expected.

● The candidate will technically lead multiple agile teams, collaborate with senior technical and business stakeholders, translate business requirements into scalable technical designs and delivery roadmaps, and communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

● The candidate must have proven experience designing and implementing at least two complete ServiceNow instances covering multiple product families, along with deep hands\-on expertise in the ServiceNow Zurich release.

● Strong expertise in CMDB architecture, CSDM v5, ITSM Pro\+, ITOM, Discovery, Service Mapping, Integration Hub, Workflow Data Fabric, Flow Designer, and IRM/GRC is required.

● The candidate should also have a strong understanding of ITIL processes, service lifecycle management, enterprise\-scale automation, ServiceNow scripting using JavaScript and Glide APIs, REST/SOAP integrations, MID Server architecture, data modelling, CI reconciliation, normalization, performance, security, upgrade\-safe design, and cloud/hybrid integration patterns.

Leadership and Certifications

● The candidate should demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills, the ability to influence architecture decisions and lead without authority, experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders, and strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.

● Knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe, is expected. ServiceNow CTA or Certified Master Architect and ITIL v4 certifications are desirable, along with relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications.

304a3dca.title: Associate Director, ERP Finance Solution Architect
304a3dca.description:
**The Position**

  

Under the direction of Organon Cross Functional Expert Lead: ERP Finance Solution Architect, this position will be accountable to gather requirement and map business process with the suitable design in SAP systems. Supporting and guiding initiatives across the global financial systems landscape by designing robust and scalable SAP FI/CO solutions that build on existing platforms. Your expertise in accounting and SAP FI/CO processes enables you to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality concepts that strengthen global financial processes.  

  

Support the Cross\-Functional Process Expert Lead by designing, governing, and improving end\-to\-end (E2E) processes across domains. Ensure process harmonization, standardization, and smooth cross\-system handoffs across ERP and enterprise data platforms.  

  

**Responsibilities**

* As a Cross Functional Expert: SAP FI\-CO Solution Architect, the candidate would be responsible for the timely completion of tasks and actions defined by the project plan.
* The candidate would be responsible to Build and expand in\-house expertise across SAP S4 HANA FI\-CO modules including GL, AP, AR, Tax, AA, CCA, PCA, Internal Orders, COPA, CO\-PC, Banking, treasury, and consolidation systems to enable delivery of high\-value use cases.
* Lead from FICO perspective, including local legal compliance requirement implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration and continuous improvement projects across multiple business units and geographies. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and document business requirements and align them with SAP FICO capabilities.
* Serve as the Technology Lead and trusted advisor to our Treasury and Finance Business Partners as we support the Treasury Management solution. Find opportunities to bring efficiencies and improvements in business processes in the area of Corporate Treasury. Support the Treasury management system which includes Bank account and Communication management, In House Cash, Netting, Intercompany payments, Lockbox processing, Bank Communication Management, Bank Statements, Interest calculations, FX and Investments. Deep subject matter and technical knowledge are both required in many of these areas.
* Identify process variants, duplication, and optimization opportunities across regions, plants, and business units. Define cross\-domain handoffs, operational controls, and integration points between systems.
* Align process standards with XLAs, business KPIs, and compliance requirements. Assess process impacts across ERP and data platforms. Maintain a cross\-system dependency matrix for E2E processes. Provide impact analysis for upcoming changes, releases, and cross\-functional initiatives. Enforce modelling standards, naming conventions, and process policies.
* Ensure proper approvals, documentation quality, and compliance with enterprise controls. Maintain the enterprise process repository and ensure consistent version management. Collaborate with Product Owners, Architecture, Data Governance, and Operations teams.


Expected Outcomes:

* Reduced process fragmentation and fewer variants across the enterprise.
* Smoother and more reliable handoffs across systems, functions, and domains.
* Better visibility into cross\-system dependencies and reduced release\-related risks.
* Standardized, high\-quality process documentation used consistently across teams.


Success Measures:

* Reduction in E2E process variants.
* Decrease in handoff\-related defects or errors.
* Process documentation quality and compliance score.
* Fewer cross\-system defects due to improved impact visibility.
* Stakeholder alignment and adoption of standard process models.


Decision Rights:

* Recommend and enforce process modelling standards.
* Approve or reject process exceptions or variants.
* Validate cross\-system impacts for major changes.
* Influence Product Owner backlogs where E2E process alignment is affected.

**Required Education, Experience and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, IT, or related discipline (or equivalent experience); Master’s degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in SAP FICO consulting, including full\-cycle implementations and post\-go\-live support.
* Expertise in SAP FICO core modules (GL, AP, AR, AA, Bank Accounting, CCA, PCA, IO, COPA, CO\-PC). Strong knowledge of cross\-module integration points with MM, SD, PS, RAR and HCM.
* Experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management, and Tax(Vertex integration) is highly desirable.
* Experience in development of solution for E\-Invoice(SAP DRC), SAFT, DMEE etc. requirements.
* Skilled in writing detailed Functional Design Specifications (FDS) and collaborating on RICEFW objects with ABAP developers.
* Experienced in using agile methodology to bring new solutions though experimental/Proof of Concept (POC) stages to a realized fully sustained solution.
* Excellent facilitation and cross\-functional alignment capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate, communicate and coordinate with business and IT stakeholders.
* Analytical, structured problem\-solving and process thinking. Ability to influence without authority and communicate clearly. Governance\-minded, detail\-oriented, and organized.

**Secondary Job Description**

**Who We Are:**

Organon delivers ingenious health solutions that enable people to live their best lives. We are a $6\.5 billion global healthcare company focused on making a world of difference for women, their families and the communities they care for. We have an important portfolio and are growing it by investing in the unmet needs of Women’s Health, expanding access to leading biosimilars and touching lives with a diverse and trusted portfolio of health solutions. Our Vision is clear: A better and healthier every day for every woman.


As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from candidates with a diverse background. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our applicants.

**Search Firm Representatives Please Read Carefully**  

Organon LLC, does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. All CVs / resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at our company without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of our company. No fee will be paid in the event a candidate is hired by our company as a result of an agency referral where no pre\-existing agreement is in place. bc15c09b.description:
We are looking for a Solution Architect – Java Full Stack (React/Angular) to lead architecture for secure, scalable fintech systems with demanding performance and uptime goals. You will collaborate with global stakeholders to define strategy, evaluate technology options, and guide delivery using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and modern UI stacks built with React and Angular on Azure or AWS. Apply now to help teams deliver reliable solutions at scale
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions that align with business requirements
* Define and execute product technology strategy with stakeholders
* Partner with senior technical and product leaders to ensure impactful, feasible designs
* Collaborate with global Solution Architecture \& Engineering teams to codify principles and best practices
* Engage with broader technical and architecture organizations to align with enterprise strategies
* Develop and review technical alternatives using current and emerging technologies
* Drive software implementation leveraging microservices\-based architecture for fintech applications
* Guide and mentor development teams to promote technical excellence and continuous improvement
* Coordinate with product owners and operations to keep software delivery seamless
* Encourage agile development principles and reinforce a collaborative team culture
* Create prototypes and help solve complex technical challenges hands on
* Advocate for technical quality and sustainable, future\-proof solutions


**Requirements**
* Extensive experience designing scalable software solutions in product engineering, including 5\+ years guiding architecture
* Strong knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals, web applications \& services, and microservices architecture
* Background delivering high\-transaction\-volume financial systems with global scalability and extreme uptime requirements
* Hands\-on experience with HTML5, CSS, and front\-end frameworks such as React and Angular
* Advanced back\-end development expertise using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot
* Working knowledge of PostgreSQL or SQL Server for large\-scale implementations
* Experience with cloud\-native technologies such as PCF, Kubernetes, Azure, or AWS
* Ability to operate effectively in Agile environments focused on collaboration and iteration
* Proven ability to mentor development teams and build continuous technical improvement habits
* Flexibility to contribute through hands\-on prototype development when solving business challenges
* Strong communication skills for bridging technical and non\-technical audiences


**Nice to have**
* Experience across Java, J2EE, RESTful APIs, React, and Angular
* Knowledge of Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Hibernate
* Familiarity with API tooling and design best practices for large\-scale systems
* Understanding of cloud and DevOps architecture, particularly with Azure or AWS
* Experience with PostgreSQL and NoSQL databases

f3bd7f31.description:
:
**ZS** is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side\-by\-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life\-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client\-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life\-changing impact to ZS.

  


 :
**ZS’s India Capability \& Expertise Center (CEC)** houses more than 60% of ZS people across three offices in New Delhi, Pune and Bengaluru. Our teams work with colleagues across North America, Europe and East Asia to create and deliver real world solutions to the clients who drive our business. The CEC maintains standards of analytical, operational and technological excellence across our capability groups. Together, our collective knowledge enables each ZS team to deliver superior results to our clients. **ZS's Scaled AI**practice is part of ZS's rich and advanced AI ecosystem, in the Architecture \& Engineering Expertise Center, focused on creating continuous business value for clients using a range of innovative machine learning, deep learning, and engineering capabilities.
Being part of Scaled AI practice allows you to collaborate with data scientists to create state\-of\-the\-art AI models, create and use cutting\-edge ML platforms, create and deploy advanced ML pipelines and manage the complete ML lifecycle. **What** **You’ll** **Do**  

* Design and implement technical features leveraging best practices for technology stack being used
* Collaborate with client\-facing teams to understand solution context and contribute to technical requirement gathering and analysis
* Work with technical architects on the team to validate design and implementation approach
* Write production\-ready code that is easily testable, understood by other developers, and accounts for edge cases and errors
* Ensure the highest quality of deliverables by following architecture/design guidelines, coding best practices, periodic design/code reviews
* Write unit tests as well as higher\-level tests to handle expected edge cases and errors gracefully, as well as happy paths
* Uses bug tracking, code review, version control, and other tools to organize and deliver work
* Participate in scrum calls and agile ceremonies, and effectively communicate work progress, issues, and dependencies
* Consistently contribute in researching \& evaluating the latest technologies through rapid learning, conducting proofs\-of\-concept and creating prototype solutions
* Support the project architect in designing modules/component of the overall project/product architecture
* Breaks down large features into estimable tasks lead estimation and can defend them with clients
* Implement complex features with limited guidance from the engineering lead. For example service or application\-wide change
* Systematically debug code issues/bugs using stack traces, logs, monitoring tools, and other resources
* Performs code/script reviews of senior engineers in the team

0eb83fb8.title: Interesting Job Opportunity: Zype - Technical Architect - Cloud/DevOps
0eb83fb8.description:
We are looking for an accomplished
 **Technical Architect with 8\+ years of experience** 
 in designing, implementing, and leading enterprise\-grade cloud, DevOps, and infrastructure solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong combination of
 **technical architecture, hands\-on engineering, automation, cloud transformation, application deployment, and technical leadership** 
 experience.
   

  

 The candidate will be responsible for architecting
 **highly available, scalable, secure, resilient, and cost\-optimized platforms** 
 while driving automation, standardization, CI/CD adoption, containerization, observability, and continuous improvement across the organization.
   

  

 The role requires a strong understanding of modern cloud\-native architectures, coupled with the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams and provide technical direction across the complete application and infrastructure lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Architecture \& AWS:**
* Design and implement enterprise\-scale AWS architectures that are secure, highly available, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective.
* Define cloud architecture standards, reference architectures, design patterns, and infrastructure best practices.
* Provide hands\-on expertise across AWS services including: VPC, EC2, EFS, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancer, IAM, CloudWatch, S3, Lifecycle Manager, SNS, Lambda, Secrets Manager, MSK, ElastiCache, ACM, DynamoDB, Security Hub, SES, S3 Glacier, Fault Injection Service, and RDS.
* Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, scalability, performance, and fault tolerance.
* Perform architecture and infrastructure reviews to identify opportunities for performance improvement, security enhancement, automation, and cost as Code \& Platform Automation:
* Architect and implement infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, following modular, reusable, version\-controlled, and scalable IaC practices.
* Establish Terraform standards covering modules, remote state, environment isolation, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Automate infrastructure configuration, provisioning, patching, backup, and operational processes.
* Develop Ansible playbooks for OS configuration, patch management, application configuration, and recurring operational activities.
* Develop robust Shell scripts for infrastructure, application, database, and log\-management automation.
* Reduce manual operational activities through automation and self\-service infrastructure capabilities.


**CI/CD \& DevSecOps Architecture**
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines using Jenkins.
* Configure and manage Jenkins environments from the ground up, including distributed build and deployment architectures.
* Integrate SonarQube/SAST, security scanning, automated testing, artifact management, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Manage artifact lifecycle and repositories using JFrog Artifactory.
* Establish standardized build, deployment, release, rollback, and promotion strategies across multiple environments.
* Troubleshoot complex pipeline, build, deployment, and integration issues and provide architectural solutions.
* Drive continuous improvement in deployment frequency, release reliability, security, and operational efficiency.


**Kubernetes, Docker \& Cloud\-Native Platforms**
* Architect and manage containerized and cloud\-native application platforms using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Design Kubernetes environments with focus on scalability, availability, security, networking, resource optimization, and operational resilience.
* Develop and manage Helm charts for standardized application deployment and configuration.
* Define best practices for Kubernetes workloads, configuration management, secrets, ingress, scaling, health checks, and deployment strategies.
* Lead application modernization initiatives involving microservices, containerization, and Kubernetes adoption.


**Application \& Database Architecture**
* Provide technical architecture and deployment expertise for microservices, Apache Tomcat, and Angular\-based applications.
* Design application deployment strategies supporting scalability, reliability, security, and seamless releases.
* Architect and manage database platforms including MySQL, MongoDB, and YugabyteDB.
* Define database provisioning, backup, recovery, high availability, monitoring, and performance\-management strategies.
* Automate database backup and maintenance activities.
* Work closely with development teams to resolve application, database, performance, and integration challenges.


**Networking, Reverse Proxy \& Traffic Management**
* Design and manage application traffic and reverse\-proxy solutions using NGINX and HAProxy.
* Configure load balancing, SSL/TLS termination, routing, health checks, and traffic\-management policies.
* Troubleshoot complex networking, connectivity, routing, and application\-access issues.
* Ensure secure and optimized communication between application, infrastructure, and cloud components.


**Observability, Monitoring \& Logging**
* Design and implement enterprise monitoring and observability strategies using AWS CloudWatch, Dynatrace, and Nagios.
* Establish infrastructure, application, service, and availability monitoring with effective alerting and escalation mechanisms.
* Implement centralized logging and log analytics using Graylog and ELK Stack.
* Develop dashboards and operational metrics to provide visibility into system health, performance, capacity, and availability.
* Define proactive monitoring and alerting strategies to minimize service disruption and improve MTTR.


**Environment, Release \& Infrastructure Management**
* Architect and manage Development, QA, UAT, Pre\-Production, and Production environments.
* Define environment\-specific infrastructure standards, sizing, capacity, security, and deployment strategies.
* Design infrastructure and instance strategies to support different application releases and workloads.
* Ensure consistency across environments through automation and Infrastructure as Code.
* Establish and maintain standards for backup, disaster recovery, patch management, security, monitoring, and operational readiness.


**Technical Leadership**
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to DevOps, Cloud, Development, QA, and IT teams.
* Translate business and application requirements into scalable and maintainable technical architectures.
* Lead architecture discussions, solution design, technology evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and technical reviews.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical infrastructure, deployment, and production issues.
* Mentor engineers and establish engineering standards, best practices, and operational processes.
* Collaborate with application and business stakeholders to ensure solutions align with business objectives.
* Drive initiatives focused on automation, reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost optimization.


**Core Technical Expertise**
* Cloud: AWS VPC, EC2, EFS, ELB, Auto Scaling, IAM, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, Secrets Manager, MSK, ElastiCache, ACM, Security Hub, Glacier, Fault Injection Service
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
* Configuration \& Automation: Ansible, Shell Scripting
* CI/CD \& DevSecOps: Jenkins, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory
* Containers \& Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
* Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, YugabyteDB
* Source Control: GitHub, GitLab
* Application Platforms: Apache Tomcat, Microservices, Angular
* Web \& Proxy: NGINX, HAProxy
* Monitoring \& Observability: AWS CloudWatch, Dynatrace, Nagios
* Logging: ELK Stack, Graylog


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Technical Architecture.
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise\-grade AWS architectures.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Terraform, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Ansible, and Shell scripting.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevSecOps, cloud\-native architecture, microservices, and automation.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, logging, observability, and production support.
* Strong understanding of networking, security, high availability, disaster recovery, scalability, and performance engineering.
* Experience working across multiple environments and supporting mission\-critical production workloads.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor engineering teams, and make architecture\-level decisions.


**What Success Looks Like**
 The successful candidate will help establish a
 **secure, scalable, automated, and highly resilient technology platform** 
 that enables development teams to deliver applications faster and more reliably.
   

  

 You will play a key role in driving
 **cloud transformation, infrastructure automation, DevSecOps adoption, Kubernetes modernization, observability, cost optimization, and operational excellence** 
 , while ensuring that technology solutions remain aligned with business and application requirements.

e8578120.title: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant
e8578120.description:
**Job Description: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant** 




**Experience Required:** 
 6–8 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (1st preference). Other locations are also fine, Chennai, Bangalore, Gurugram, Pune, Mumbai, Kolkata
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud General Ledger (GL) Support Consultant with strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Cloud GL, with proven experience resolving production issues, handling period\-close activities, and providing day\-to\-day operational support in a live Oracle Cloud Financials environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle Cloud General Ledger module, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests within defined SLAs
* Manage and troubleshoot day\-to\-day GL issues: journal posting errors, allocation failures, reconciliation mismatches, ledger balancing issues
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities including journal review, accruals, revaluation, translation, and consolidation
* Monitor and resolve issues in scheduled processes (ESS jobs) related to GL — posting, import, allocations, period close
* Handle intercompany transactions, elimination entries, and cross\-ledger balancing issues
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and recommend permanent fixes/configuration changes
* Coordinate with Oracle Support (SRs/Service Requests) for bug fixes, patches, and quarterly update issues
* Support functional testing of Oracle Cloud quarterly patches/updates and regression testing for GL processes
* Work closely with subledger (AP, AR, FA \& CM) support teams to resolve cross\-module integration issues impacting GL
* Assist in FBDI\-based data loads, journal uploads, and correction of failed interface/import processes
* Maintain and update support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Handle minor enhancements, CRs (Change Requests), and configuration updates as per business need
* Provide end\-user support, training, and query resolution related to GL processes
* Track tickets via ITSM tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and report on SLA compliance and ticket trends
* Participate in on\-call/rotational support and be available during period\-close windows (including weekends, if required)



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 6–8 years of experience in Oracle applications, with at least 4–5 years dedicated to Oracle Cloud GL support/operations
* Strong hands\-on experience in a
 **production support environment**
* Solid understanding of GL configurations: Chart of Accounts, Ledgers, Calendars, Journal Sources/Categories, Data Access Sets
* Practical experience with allocations, revaluation, translation, and consolidation processes
* Experience handling period\-close cycle issues and providing close\-window support
* Working knowledge of GL integration points with AP, AR, FA, CM, and Expenses
* Hands\-on experience with OTBI, FRS (Financial Reporting Studio), and Smart View for troubleshooting/reporting issues
* Familiarity with FBDI templates and resolving failed import/interface issues
* Experience raising and managing Oracle Service Requests (SRs) via My Oracle Support (MOS)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud release cycles (quarterly updates) and their impact on GL configurations
* Good knowledge of ITSM/ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy)
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize under pressure



  





**Preferred/Good to Have** 



* Oracle Cloud Financials (GL) certification
* Prior experience in AMS/support engagements (as opposed to only implementation projects)
* Exposure to SLA\-driven support models and ticket\-severity frameworks (P1/P2/P3\)
* Basic understanding of SQL for data validation/debugging (not mandatory)



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset with a sense of urgency during close periods
* Good client communication and ticket documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tickets/priorities simultaneously
* Team player with willingness to support on\-call/rotational schedules

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.



Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.



If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

 **Work Hours:** Night Shift (7:00 PM \- 3:00 AM IST)


**Location:** Bengaluru


**In\-Office Expectation:** This role is primarily shift\-based. As the office does not currently operate between 8:00 PM and 8:00 AM, work during these hours will be performed remotely until further notice. The Company reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to modify office operating hours and require in\-office work in the future.



Employees may be required to work onsite on an occasional basis for team collaboration, meetings, or other business needs. Accordingly, candidates must be based in Bengaluru and maintain the ability to work from Nextiva’s office located at Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048, as required.



Specific work schedules and any flexibility will be determined by the employee’s reporting manager in alignment with business requirements and team collaboration needs.



This role serves as a growth path into AI Solutions Engineering, Product Specialist opportunities, or Customer Success Leadership. At Nextiva, all team members working a standard shift are expected to work onsite, supporting a highly collaborative, in\-person team environment.



**About the Role:**



Nextiva is looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **AI Implementation / Customer Success Engineer** to help deploy AI solutions for customers, design high\-quality conversational experiences, and manage end\-to\-end agent implementations. This role blends technical skills, prompt engineering, workflow design, and customer\-facing responsibilities to ensure successful delivery of AI\-driven customer experience products.



You will work closely with product, engineering, and customer success teams to translate business needs into scalable AI workflows and optimized conversational agents.


**Key Responsibilities:**



AI Agent Implementation \& Prompt Engineering


* Design, build, and optimize AI agents using advanced prompt engineering techniques.
* Create structured workflows and decision trees that guide AI agent behavior.
* Use LLMs such as **GPT\-4o, Gemini, Claude, Llama** etc., to build, test, and refine agents.
* Implement **function\-calling / tool\-calling** capability within prompts using simple UI builders.
* Configure constraints and guardrails to reduce hallucinations and ensure reliable outputs.


Customer\-Facing Implementation


* Work directly with customers to understand business needs, use cases, workflows, and integration requirements.
* Translate customer requirements into technical implementation plans.
* Assist in onboarding, deployment, and testing of AI solutions for customer environments.
* Provide ongoing optimization and support to ensure solution adoption and success.


Workflow \& Integration Management


* Build, maintain, and optimize automation workflows using platform workflow builders.
* Integrate agents with customer tools, APIs, CRMs, or communication platforms where needed.
* Troubleshoot workflow, configuration, or data issues during implementation.


Conversation \& Experience Design


* Create high\-quality conversation flows for AI agents, ensuring clarity, tone, and brand alignment.
* Apply AI conversation design principles to improve user satisfaction and agent performance.


Technical Skills \& Development

70033c9f.title: Technical Program Manager
70033c9f.description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You'll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. You'll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why we're building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on IC role and you'll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working\-hour overlap with our Asia\-based Tech Team.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.


**What You’ll Own**
* Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.
* Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross\-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.
* Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.
* Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.
* Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.
* Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow\-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* At least 3\+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.
* A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross\-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data\-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.
* Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.
* Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.
* First\-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.
* Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process aren't fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.
* Strong cross\-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer\-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.
* High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.
* Startup mindset: You enjoy working in a lean environment where there isn't a dedicated person for every function. You're willing to get into the details, solve problems yourself, and build lightweight processes when they are genuinely useful.


**What’s In It For You**
* Own a high\-leverage problem: You'll be the person responsible for keeping delivery moving across teams, directly influencing how quickly and reliably we turn product ideas into something customers can use.
* Work at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, and Logistics: Our products combine software, data, machine learning, and deep logistics expertise. You'll get exposure to complex product problems where the challenge isn't simply building software, but making sure data, models, workflows, and customer needs come together.
* Real impact from day one: we’re lean by design so you'll have a high degree of ownership. There is no large PMO or layer of project managers around you. You'll need to be comfortable getting into the details, figuring things out independently, and knowing when something needs to be pushed, clarified, escalated, or simply solved.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO**
* Curiosity: We dig into why something's slipping, not just how to patch it. We stay close to the work and the data.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We hold a project together end to end and stay on it until it ships cleanly.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for "it launched." We aim for delivery that's predictable, aligned, and free of last\-minute surprises.
* Effective: We focus on shipping what was actually intended, on time, with real impact, not process for its own sake.


 Join us at Portcast in our vision to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
