7e87f8bd.title: Business Solutions Lead Architect
7e87f8bd.description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Lead Architect owns the end\-to\-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands\-on architecture of cloud\-ready, event\-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle \- setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future\-proof solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture.
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams.
* Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions.
* Design and oversee the development of Java\-based, cloud\-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event\-driven architectures.
* Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture.
* Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks.
* Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape.
* Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support).
* Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices.
* Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption.
* Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability.
* Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
* Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities


**Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3\+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale, distributed applications and microservices.
* Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security).
* Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required.
* Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies.
* Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles.
* Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

f64ad028.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
f64ad028.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

9e0d71bb.title: AI Solutions Architect
9e0d71bb.description:
Clinisys is a leading global provider of intelligent informatics solutions, offering advanced technologies and expert services that transform modern laboratory operations across diverse sectors such as healthcare, life sciences, public health, environmental testing, water quality, toxicology, and contract services. Through its platform and cloud\-based solutions, Clinisys empowers over 3,000 laboratories in 34 countries to generate millions of analytical and diagnostic results, and data insights every day, supporting more efficient and effective workflows for laboratories and testing environments worldwide.
   

  

 Headquartered in Tucson, Arizona, and Woking, England, Clinisys’ mission is to enhance the effectiveness of diagnostic workflows in any laboratory or testing environment and keep citizens and communities healthier and safer.
   

  

**Clinisys' AI Philosophy**
 Building an AI‑first organisation is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve, must drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.
   

  

**Purpose (of The Role)**
 As an AI Solutions Architect and a member of a dynamic and multi\-functional Agile development team, you will play a pivotal role in championing AI\-enabled capabilities into software development operations and commercialized product offerings. Clinisys is building a dedicated AI engineering team to transform how laboratories configure and interact with LIMS and LIS products. The AI Solutions Architect will lead the technical design and integration of agentic AI systems that simplify workflows, reduce configuration time, and align with our Microsoft\-first technology strategy. This role will set the technical standard for AI development at Clinisys, guiding both the dedicated AI team and enabling full\-stack engineers to contribute effectively.
   

  

 Practical experience in deploying AI solutions in a Production environment is essential. Your hands\-on experience and past leadership experience using GenAI tools—such as ChatGPT, Copilot, etc. and your familiarity with the latest versions of popular LLMs such as Claude or GPT\-X—as well as a strong foundational understanding of other AI domains (NLP, Predictive Analytics, Computer Vision) will be instrumental in creating operational efficiencies and commercialized product features.
   

  

 You will collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and data scientists to deliver and champion AI\-enabled, GenAI, and agentic solutions for our customers to help drive their productivity. You will lead the process improvement initiatives within the SDLC to ensure applicable areas are AI\-enabled, creating agentic workflows were needed, which can include user\-story generation, code\-generation, test\-automation, PR automation etc.
   

  

 You will design, host, and deploy AI\-enabled solutions—including GenAI, Predictive Analytics, LLM, and RAG—ensuring effective integration with Clinisys applications. You are also responsible for cost\-efficient cloud architecture for both internal and external solutions.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* AI Architecture Design: Lead the design of AI\-enabled, GenAI, LLM and RAG, solutions that integrate with LIMS/LIS platforms to support sample tracking, test result interpretation, anomaly detection, and workflow optimization.
* Architect scalable, secure, and compliant AI systems using Microsoft Azure services:
* Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus
* Design agentic workflows that allow an LLM\-powered assistant to autonomously build and modify configurations within LIMS/LIS products
* Create reference implementations and reusable components for full\-stack engineers to extend AI functionality
* Lead architecture reviews and technical workshops to align engineering practices across teams
* Define API contracts and integration patterns between AI services and product backends:
* .NET (C\#), RDBMS, SQL Server , Oracle, NoSQL, Azure Cosmos, MongoDB, RESTful APIs
* Data Integration \& Governance: Architect secure and scalable pipelines for ingesting structured and unstructured lab data (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ASTM, DICOM) while ensuring compliance with CLIA, CAP, HIPAA, and GDPR.
* Collaboration: Partner with lab directors, pathologists, and clinical informatics teams to translate diagnostic and operational needs into AI capabilities.
* Collaborate with product engineering teams to embed AI capabilities into existing UIs and workflows
* Model Development \& Deployment: Oversee the lifecycle of AI models, including training, validation, deployment, and monitoring in regulated environments.
* Automation \& Efficiency: Drive intelligent automation initiatives such as auto\-verification of results, smart routing of samples, and predictive maintenance of lab instruments.
* Compliance \& Explainability: Ensure AI solutions meet regulatory standards and provide explainable outputs suitable for clinical environments.
* Innovation Leadership: Evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., LLMs and RAG for lab report summarization, computer vision for slide analysis) and lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives.


**Skills Needed To Be Successful**
* Strong architectural thinking with the ability to design scalable, modular, and secure AI systems
* Deep understanding of large language models (LLMs) and RAG, agentic systems, and workflow orchestration
* Proficiency in both Python and .NET (C\#) for building production\-grade AI services and APIs
* Expertise in Microsoft Azure services, including Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, and Azure DevOps
* Ability to translate business and domain\-specific requirements into technical solutions
* Strong communication and mentoring skills to guide engineers and influence cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to healthcare and life sciences
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment with evolving priorities
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


**Required Experience \& Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
* 8\+ years of experience in software architecture or engineering
* 3\+ years of experience designing and implementing AI/ML systems in production environments
* Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and infrastructure
* Proven track record of integrating AI systems into enterprise software products


**Preferred Experience \& Education**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
* Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, or environmental sciences
* Familiarity with laboratory information systems (LIMS/LIS) or scientific data workflows
* Experience with embedding AI assistants or chatbots into enterprise applications
* Knowledge of prompt engineering, vector databases, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
* This role does not have direct reports initially but will:
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to AI engineers and full\-stack contributors
* Influence architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams
* Help define future team structure and hiring needs as the AI initiative scales
* AI Architecture Design: Lead the design of AI/ML solutions that integrate with LIMS/LIS platforms to support sample tracking, test result interpretation, anomaly detection, and workflow optimization.
* Data Integration \& Governance: Architect secure and scalable pipelines for ingesting structured and unstructured lab data (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ASTM, DICOM) while ensuring compliance with CLIA, CAP, HIPAA, and GDPR.
* Clinical Collaboration: Partner with lab directors, pathologists, and clinical informatics teams to translate diagnostic and operational needs into AI capabilities.
* Model Development \& Deployment: Oversee the lifecycle of AI models, including training, validation, deployment, and monitoring in regulated environments.
* Automation \& Efficiency: Drive intelligent automation initiatives such as auto\-verification of results, smart routing of samples, and predictive maintenance of lab instruments.
* Compliance \& Explainability: Ensure AI solutions meet regulatory standards and provide explainable outputs suitable for clinical environments.
* Innovation Leadership: Evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., LLMs for lab report summarization, computer vision for slide analysis) and lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives.

c3026f9a.title: AWS Cloud Engineer
c3026f9a.description:
**Your Career, Accelerated** 




 Vivanti, Australia's leading technology data and analytics consulting firm, is growing their team in their Bengaluru Global Delivery Center.
 



 Vivanti was founded as a platform for talented technologists who want to make a real impact for their clients. Some of the world’s biggest businesses turn to us to help bring their data strategy, AI, cloud engineering and digital solutions to life. We’re the home base for talented technologists who want more and are looking to take their career to the next level by having more learning, more variety, more support and more chances to do meaningful work.
 



 Our consultants use emerging technologies and best practices to help clients become more data driven across a range of industries. Recent projects include building a customer data platform for a leading Airline, an IoT based real\-time driver safety dashboard for a global logistics firm, architecture advisory for Australia’s largest radio network, a full fledged enterprise cloud and data platform for the world’s leading medical aid manufacturing company, to name a few.
 



 We work with all the major technologies used in the market today and are partners with some of the largest names in the industry i.e. Databricks, Snowflake, Google, AWS, Azure and many more.
 



 If that sounds like the kind of place you’d thrive in, keep reading.
 



  





**What You’ll Get** 




 We know you're bringing the skills, the passion and the drive. What we bring is the platform to help you go further.
 



 At Vivanti, you're not just taking a job, you're investing in your growth.
 



 Here’s a taste:
 


* A platform for growth: Work across industries, clients and technologies that stretch your thinking and build your personal and professional skills.
* Access global businesses: Work with some of the world's biggest brands
* IP, frameworks and accelerators: We share what we know. Our playbooks and toolkits fast\-track your success on projects.
* Access to a broad ecosystem of technologies
* Senior consultants who have your back: You’ll always have a guide on your journey, not just be thrown into the deep end.
* Serious learning support: Paid certs, weekly training, guilds, hackathons, mentoring and more.
* Progress that’s transparent: Annual Progress Reviews based on 360° feedback, not vague vibes. Clear goals, solid feedback and real growth.
* Toastmasters and Pitch sessions to embrace your public speaking and leadership skills
* Hackathons to gear up for technologies on the horizon
* Comprehensive Health Insurance
* Kudos and rewards: We celebrate wins, reward impact and offer long\-term incentives.
* Real connection: From Friday socials to annual team building days \- we work hard and play harder.



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 Scaling and Operating a robust AWS platform:\-
 


* Act as a technical lighthouse. You’ll join client reviews to explain why they should migrate to EKS, adopt Serverless, or rethink their Disaster Recovery strategy.
* Design, deploy, and maintain multi\-tenant AWS environments using Terraform. You’ll ensure that "manual change" isn't in our vocabulary.
* Build and optimize deployment pipelines (GitLab CI) that allow our clients to ship code safely and frequently without waking you up at 3 AM.
* Identify repetitive operational tasks, from certificate renewals to environment provisioning, and write the Python or Go code to automate them away
* Implement "Observe\-everything" stacks using Amazon CloudWatch,
 
 and Open Telemetry



 Designing and Scaling the next generation of LLM workloads on AWS Bedrock
 


* Operationalize AWS Bedrock by managing model access, provisioning "Provisioned Throughput" for consistent performance.
* Deploy and maintain the "plumbing" for Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), including Bedrock Knowledge Bases and vector databases.
* Implement Bedrock Guardrails to enforce content filtering and PII masking, ensuring client AI applications stay within safety and compliance boundaries.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 4\+ years deep familiarity with AWS products and services, including:
 


* Serverless architecture with Lambda, ECS and Fargate
* Expertise in cloud networking (security groups, WAF, ALBs, API Gateway, etc)
* Cloud governance with IAM roles and permissions
* Knowledge of AWS AI offerings including AWS Bedrock Agentcore, AWS Strands, and Bedrock KnowledgeBases
* Operational reporting and monitoring with CloudWatch and Open Telemetry
* Experience with IaC frameworks like Terraform and Cloud Formation
* Strong fundamentals in Linux, scripting, automation



**If you don’t have 4\+ years of deep AWS experience, this might not be the right fit just yet.** 
 We encourage you to keep building those cloud muscles and look out for our mid\-level openings in the future!
 



  





**Why Explore a Career at Vivanti** 




 We are a consultant led organisation. We invest heavily in our consultants to ensure they have the technical skills and commercial acumen to be successful in their work. Our consultants have a passion for data and solving complex problems. They are curious, ambitious and experts in their fields. We have developed a first rate team so you will be supported and learn from the best.
 



 We invest heavily in professional development both technically, through training and guided certification pathways, and in consulting, through workshops in client engagement and communication. Growth in our organisation happens from growth in our people.
 



 Working on your own macbooks in our custom designed offices in the heart of Bengaluru, away from the big tech parks, we provide a peaceful and productive work environment close to shops, parks and metro stations.
 



 Vivanti consultants engage with the business to give expert advice, solve problems and deliver data, analytics, digital, AI, customer and cloud solutions, by drawing on years of experience across diverse projects, industries and technologies!
 



  





**The Vivanti Interview Process** 




 We like keeping it to the point and explore a candidate's competence through 4 stages of:
 


* A technical online screening test where we do a baseline assessment of your problem solving skills
* Introductory and Cultural Assessment to make sure we are all on the same page in terms of our growth and career prospects.
* Technical Assessment to understand your technical competency assessed by our technical panel.
* Final Round to make sure the technicality is in balance with the aptitude and culture fit.



 And after this, you pack and join us: )

27a065d5.title: Sr. Program Manager-Customer Delight Engine
27a065d5.description:
**The Title Is Familiar. The Job Is Not.**
Most Sr. Program Manager roles are coordination layers. Status meetings. Slide decks. Nudging people
to reply to emails. This is none of that.
We are building GoComet's Customer Delight Engine — an AI\-native function that transforms how
enterprise accounts experience value. Getting there requires someone who can hold the entire
operating system together while we rebuild it from the inside.
Your success is not measured by what you organised. It's measured by whether the transformation
actually happened.  

You are not the person who reports on the org. You are the person who runs it.
If you think in outcomes, not tasks — keep reading. **Why This Role Exists**
GoComet serves enterprise accounts at $250K–$1M\+ ARR. At this scale, a failure to deliver outcomes
is not just a bad quarter — it is a reference story that closes future doors.
We are transforming the Customer Delight Engine into an AI\-native function — moving from traditional
SaaS implementation toward outcome\-driven delivery, where intelligence replaces rigid workflows and
results replace activity.
That transformation doesn't happen because we planned it well. It happens because someone holds the
entire operating system together while we rebuild it from the inside.
When the Head of the Customer Delight Engine is away for a quarter — nothing should break.
Everything should run. That is the bar for this role. **What You Will Own** **Delivery Governance**
Full visibility of every client engagement. Stage, health, risk, and escalation — in real time. You know
before anyone else when something is slipping. Every project tracker reflects outcome commitments,
not just task lists. **Process Enforcement**Four cycles. SOPs. Anchor PM. PRD discipline. You audit. You flag. You close gaps. If it's documented
but not followed — that's your queue to fix the problem. **Statement of Work Alignment**
What was sold must match what is being built. You track fidelity between commercial commitments and
delivery reality. Drift gets flagged before it becomes a loss — for GoComet or for the customer. **Customer Outcome Mapping**
PMs, CSMs, and Solution Specialists must track outcomes — not milestones. You ensure the entire
Customer Delight Engine is measuring what changes in the real world for the customer, not just what
tasks got closed. **Hiring Operations**
Every open position in the Customer Delight Engine is your responsibility. Not to recruit — to own
velocity and quality. Positions moving, candidates coming in. You drive this.
Staffing \& Resourcing  

You own the staffing plan aligned to our AI\-native transformation roadmap. Is there enough capacity?
Are gaps visible before they become delivery failures? Is the plan keeping pace with where we are
heading? **POD Structure**
GoComet runs customer\-aligned PODs. You assess their health, spot structural problems, and drive
improvements. Handoffs clean. Roles clear. Escalation paths working.**Transformation Metrics**
Two metrics. Both must rise together: Revenue per Employee and Tokens per Employee. You own
the measurement, the reporting, and the accountability for whether the Customer Delight Engine is
genuinely moving toward AI\-native delivery — or just saying it is.**AI\-Native Product Initiatives**
You drive initiatives that make the Customer Delight Engine progressively more AI\-native — AI\-powered
integrations, outcome dashboards CSMs can build themselves, configuration\-driven workflows that
remove engineering dependency. You do not just manage these. You ensure these are delivered.  

How You'll Work**As the Operator**
Weekly delivery reviews. Cross\-team process enforcement. Trackers and systems that make
accountability structural. You do not chase people — you build systems, so they do not need to be
chased.**As the Transformation Driver**
You use AI tools to drive the internal transformation of the Customer Delight Engine — not to build
products, but to change how the org itself works. You prototype AI\-native alternatives to how the team
currently operates, demonstrate what a transformed delivery function looks like in practice, and drive
adoption from the inside. The people who need to change how they work need to see what is possible
first. You are the one who shows them.**As the Anchor**
You are the connective tissue between Sales, Discovery, Build, and Deploy. When something falls
through the gap between teams — that is your gap. You own it. You close it. **Who You Are**
You don't ask: "What should we track?" You ask: "What must change in the real world for this to matter?" **Must\-Have*** 5–7 years across delivery, product, transformation, or operations roles — ideally a combination, not


a single track* Led or managed large\-scale digital transformation programs across multiple organisations or teams


simultaneously* Heavy stakeholder management — business leaders, enterprise customers, cross\-functional


teams, all at once* Strong process design and enforcement background — has built SOPs in complex environments


and made them actually stick* Enterprise B2B exposure — understands how implementation quality drives renewal, expansion,


and reference value* Technical sensibility: not a developer, but not intimidated by tech. Can read architecture


diagrams, understand integration patterns, and hold substantive conversations with engineers* Can use AI tools to build working proof\-of\-concepts — Claude, GPT, Cursor, or equivalent. Not


just as a user — as a builder* Understands LLM concepts at a working level — enough to evaluate, drive, and communicate


AI\-native delivery initiatives* Outcome\-obsessed — knows the difference between a team that is busy and a team that is


delivering **Nice to Have*** Background in logistics, freight, or supply chain operations
* Experience building internal AI tools, agents, or workflow automations
* Has previously acted as a deputy or operator for a senior leader
* Zero\-to\-one product or platform experience

 **What This Role Is NOT*** Not a Sr. Program Manager who manages calendars and owns meeting notes
* Not a programme manager who tracks task completion
* Not an analyst who builds decks and hands them upward
* Not a consultant who recommends changes and moves on

29526d44.title: Sr Program Manager
29526d44.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**


**Location: Banglaore / Mumbai / Gurgaon**





 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 The Senior Program Manager will be a member of the LinkedIn Sales Solutions – Program Management Office reporting to the Chief of Staff to the Global Vice President for Sales, LinkedIn Sales Solutions who is also the Managing Director for LinkedIn's APAC business.
   

  

  

  

 This position offers an exciting opportunity to act as a partner and advisor to senior leaders and cross\-functional teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Marketing, Legal, Trust, Information Security, Business Development, and other functions. LinkedIn Sales Solutions is launching a new product and the primary focus of the role will be to lead program management across pilot execution, commercialization, and general availability readiness, helping the business translate pilot learnings into coordinated product, go\-to\-market, operational, and customer\-readiness plans.
   

  





 This role will operate at the systems level across a globally distributed set of workstreams. The Senior Program Manager will establish clear governance, surface cross\-program risks and dependencies, drive decisions through the appropriate forums, and keep leaders and working teams aligned on outcomes, ownership, milestones, and success measures.
   

  





 The role is based in India and will require regular collaboration across India, Singapore, and North American time zones. Some travel may be required (1\-2 trips per year).
   

  





**Responsibilities:**




 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
   

  




* Build strong, trust\-based relationships with India, APAC, and global leaders, workstream owners, cross\-functional partners, and executive stakeholders.
* Own and maintain the integrated new product program plan across pilot phases, commercialization, and general availability readiness, with clear milestones, decision points, dependencies, owners, and success measures.
* Design and operate effective program governance, including cross\-functional program\-team forums that surface system\-level issues and executive steering forums that resolve risks, dependencies, blockers, and trade\-offs.
* Maintain a clear view of risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and opportunities; develop practical recommendations; and drive timely escalation and resolution, driving the communications cadence, coordinating dependencies across workstreams, and ensuring readiness across pilot customers.
* Ensure workstreams are appropriately scoped and resourced, with clear decision rights, accountable owners, and engaged working\-team members.
* Own updates to senior stakeholders, including progress against milestones, highlights and lowlights, key risks, and actions required.
* Translate commercial model and customer pilot learnings into coordinated readiness plans for product scalability, customer experience, sales execution, operational processes, reporting, and launch communications.
* Over time, extend program management support to other strategic LinkedIn Sales Solutions priorities.


**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**



* 8\+ years of industry experience in the technology or internet sector, or in management consulting.
* BA or BS degree.



**Preferred Qualifications:**



* 5\+ years of experience managing complex programs or projects across multiple cross\-functional teams.
* Experience working in a global role and proven ability to work effectively in a complex, global, matrixed organization across functions, geographies, and time zones.
* Experience leading a complex product commercialization, go\-to\-market, or launch\-readiness program from pilot through general availability.
* Experience operating customer\-facing pilots, including milestone tracking, escalation management, dependency coordination, and readiness planning.
* Experience partnering with Director\+ level and executive stakeholders and influencing decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complexity into clear executive updates, decisions, and recommendations.
* Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, create structure, and maintain momentum with limited supervision.
* Experience working with or within Sales, Customer Success, Media, SaaS, or other go\-to\-market organizations.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple simultaneous workstreams in a high\-growth, performance\-focused environment.
* Experience with organizational change management is a plus.
* MBA, advanced degree, or PMP certification is a plus.



**Suggested Skills:**



* Program and project management
* Executive communication
* Stakeholder management
* Cross\-functional collaboration
* Governance, risk, and dependency management
* Problem solving
* Go\-to\-market and launch readiness


**Additional Information**

For more information on our equal opportunity policy, please visit https://legal.linkedin.com/content/dam/legal/Policy\_India\_EqualOppPWD\_9\-12\-2023\.pdf

9dea26c2.title: Lead System Architect & Technical Program Manager
9dea26c2.description:
We are seeking a visionary and execution\-oriented
 **Lead System Architect \& Technical Program Manager (TPM)** 
 to lead the execution of our high\-priority, large\-scale technical initiatives for the CitiDirect Platform Core and Platform Digital Servicing Agile Release Trains (ARTs). This is a unique, hybrid role designed for a senior technical leader who can both design complex, enterprise\-grade system architectures and actively drive their execution across both ARTs.
   

  

 In this role, your primary focus will be
 **System Architecture** 
 —defining the technical vision, designing scalable system architectures, and building the architectural runway. Concurrently, you will leverage
 **Technical Program Management** 
 competencies to operationalize your designs, manage cross\-team technical dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure the successful delivery of high\-priority technical initiatives.
   

  

 You will serve as the ultimate technical authority for the CitiDirect Platform ARTs, bridging the gap between high\-level enterprise strategy and hands\-on engineering execution.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* System Architecture \& Technical Strategy (Primary Focus \- 70%)
* Architectural Vision \& Design: Define and communicate the future\-state architecture, technical vision, and system design patterns for the platforms within the Platform ARTs.
* Architectural Runway: Design and champion Enabler Epics and Features (covering cloud infrastructure, microservices, security, and data architecture) to ensure the platform supports near\-term business features without technical debt.
* Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs): Define, monitor, and enforce NFRs—including security, scalability, high availability, performance, and maintainability—across the ART scrum teams.
* Technical Debt \& Modernization: Identify systemic technical debt, prioritize remediation efforts, and lead architectural spikes or prototyping for new technology evaluations.
* Engineering Standards: Establish and promote modern engineering practices, including DevSecOps, Test\-Driven Development (TDD), automated testing, and API\-first design patterns.
* Technical Program Management \& Execution (30%)
* Program Delivery Coordination: Partner with the Release Train Engineer (RTE) to facilitate PI (Program Increment) execution, ensuring that engineering teams deliver on technical milestones and architectural enablers.
* Dependency \& Risk Management: Proactively identify, map, and resolve complex technical dependencies across multiple partner ARTs.
* Risk Mitigation: Lead the identification of program\-level technical risks and systematically address them through stakeholder engagement – product, architecture and engineering.
* Backlog Prioritization: Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners (POs) to refine the Program Backlog to ensure epics/tasks are always available for upcoming PIs.
* Technical Translation: Translate complex architectural designs, non\-functional requirements (NFRs), and security mandates into clear, actionable features and user stories for engineering teams.
* Stakeholder Communication: Provide transparent, data\-driven status updates, technical risk assessments, and delivery metrics to senior leadership and stakeholders.


 Key SAFe Ceremony Involvements
   

  

* PI Planning: Present the Architectural Vision and technical context to the ART; facilitate technical breakout sessions to validate team\-level designs, map dependencies on the Program Board, and draft technical PI objectives.
* ART Sync / Scrum of Scrums: Act as the primary technical escalation point to resolve architectural blockers, infrastructure issues, and cross\-team dependencies.
* System Demo: Lead the evaluation of the integrated system demo to ensure architectural integrity, interoperability, and NFR compliance.
* Inspect \& Adapt (I\&A): Lead problem\-solving workshops to address systemic technical, architectural, or infrastructure bottlenecks identified during the PI.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
 Required:
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience:
+ 7\+ years of experience in software engineering, system design, and enterprise\-scale architecture.
+ Deep, hands\-on experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.

* Technical Depth:
+ Proven expertise in designing and deploying cloud\-native architectures (ECS, AWS), microservices, and event\-driven systems.
+ Strong understanding of DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Kubernetes/Docker), and modern data architectures.


 Preferred Certifications:
   

  
+ Architecture: SAFe® System Architect (ARCH), AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
+ Agile/Program Management: SAFe® Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM), SAFe® Release Train Engineer (RTE), or Project Management Professional (PMP).


 Core Competencies
   

  
+ Architectural/Technical Authority: Strong technical credibility to guide, mentor, and gain the respect of senior engineers, tech leads, and system architects.
+ Strategic Execution: Exceptional ability to translate abstract architectural concepts into concrete, phased execution plans.
+ Influence \& Collaboration: Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority.

**Systemic Problem Solving:** 
 A track record of diagnosing and resolving complex, systemic technical blockers across highly matrixed organizations.

74218bd4.title: Solutions Engineer (AI, Identity & Data Security)
74218bd4.description:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 Solutions Engineer (AI, Identity \& Data Security) Location: \[India] Minimum Experience: 8\+ years in Pre\-Sales/ Solution Engineering or a similar senior technical customer\-facing role
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The Sales Engineer is the technical authority and narrative driver in customer engagements. This role is responsible for translating complex AI, Identity, and Data Protection challenges into defensible, real\-world solutions—while helping customers understand not just how something works, but why it matters. This role blends deep hands\-on technical expertise with storytelling, big\-picture (“paint the picture”) thinking, and collaborative problem solving. You will work with prospects to obtain the technical win by designing a viable technical solution with an amazing product that can be applied to various scenarios. You will operate across AI security, LLMs, AI agents, MCP, DLP, and Identity, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to close deals and influence product direction.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  





**Technical Discovery \& Storytelling** 



* Lead technical discovery for AI security, DLP, and Identity\-driven use cases.
* Translate complex security architectures into clear narratives that resonate with:
* CISOs and VP’s
* Security leaders
* Architects
* Engineers
* Business stakeholders
* “Paint the big picture” by connecting AI usage, identity trust, and data protection into a cohesive story.
* Clearly articulate what problems are solvable today, what are partially solvable, and what are structural limitations.



  





**Architecture \& Solution Design** 



* Design and present end\-to\-end architectures covering:
* LLM and AI agent workflows (human \+ non\-human identities)
* Data protection, inspection, and policy enforcement
* Identity, authentication, authorization, and trust boundaries
* Build, configure, and run demos and POCs using Dockerized components.
* Integrate enterprise environments including:
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta
* Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro
* Explain and demonstrate AI pipelines using:
* LangChain, LangGraph
* MCP\-style agent orchestration patterns
* Lead deep dives into DLP architectures, including:
* What DLP can realistically detect and enforce
* Where traditional DLP breaks down (AI, agents, encrypted channels, context loss)
* Common false assumptions customers have about DLP coverage
* Help customers understand enforcement gaps, bypass scenarios, and risk trade\-offs without overselling.



  





**Workshops \& Collaborative Problem Solving** 



* Facilitate technical workshops and brainstorming sessions with customer teams.
* Co\-design architectures and controls with customers rather than prescribing static solutions.
* Whiteboard flows covering:
* AI access paths
* Identity trust boundaries
* Data movement and enforcement points
* Use workshops to uncover real constraints and drive solution alignment.



  





**Execution \& Field Innovation** 



* Troubleshoot complex issues across AI pipelines, identity flows, and data paths.
* Create interim or custom solutions using Python, YAML, and cloud services when product features are missing.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility and relay field feedback.
* Maintain technical assets, demo configurations, and documentation in GitHub.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Deep, practical understanding of Data Loss Prevention (DLP):
* Inspection, classification, enforcement points
* Real\-world limitations and bypass scenarios
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of:
* AI systems, LLMs, AI agents
* Emerging AI security risks and abuse patterns
* Solid foundation in Identity \& Access Management (IAM):
* SSO, OAuth/OIDC, tokens, policy enforcement
* Practical experience with:
* Docker
* Linux
* Python
* YAML\-based configuration
* Familiarity with endpoint and device trust tooling:
* Microsoft Intune
* Jamf Pro
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Comfortable using GitHub for code, configs, and version control.
* Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive\-level presentation skills.
* Ability to lead workshops, whiteboard complex systems, and drive collaborative design sessions.
* Experience in an early startup environment preferred.



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





  




* Customers trust you not just as a technologist, but as a strategic advisor.
* Complex AI, identity, and DLP concepts are understood clearly at every stakeholder level.
* POCs reflect real customer constraints, not idealized lab conditions.
* Workshops result in alignment, not confusion.
* Deals move forward because solutions are credible, transparent, and defensible—even as the product evolves.

415b50f3.title: Solutions Engineer - I
415b50f3.description:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. We build syncOS — the industry\-first no\-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.
   

  

 As Botsync scales AMR demos across India and Southeast Asia, this Solution Engineer role owns everything between the demo fleet in Bengaluru and a live, working robot on a customer's floor — commissioning, running, and troubleshooting demos that convert prospects into customers.
   

  

**The roles and responsibilities:**
**Running demos on customer sites**
* Travel to customer plants and warehouses across India and Southeast Asia to set up and run live AMR demonstrations, typically 1 to 3 demos a month
* Unpack, commission and map a MAG\-series AMR on an unfamiliar floor within a single shift: network setup, mapping, waypoint and route configuration in syncOS, charging and docking checks
* Run the demo itself in front of plant managers, operations heads and safety teams, narrating what the robot is doing and answering questions on payload, navigation, safety and charging
* Diagnose and recover live on site when a floor behaves differently from the plan: reflective surfaces, poor WiFi coverage, uneven docking, changing traffic around the route
* Work to site rules at all times: PPE, permit\-to\-work, and safe operation around forklifts, pedestrians and live production


**Demo fleet readiness and logistics**
* Own the readiness of the demo fleet: batteries, chargers, magnetic tape, tote and trolley attachments, spares kit, and syncOS software versions matched to the demo scope
* Test every configuration end to end at the Bengaluru facility before it ships, so no robot leaves with a known open issue
* Coordinate packing, freight, customs paperwork and site access with operations for each demo, including cross\-border shipments into Southeast Asia
* Maintain the demo asset log and calibration records, and flag units that need refurbishment before they fail in front of a customer


**Feeding the sales and product loop**
* Work with the sales team before each visit to understand the customer's material flow and agree what the demo must prove: cycle time, payload, route, or integration with existing lines
* Write a short demo report within two working days covering what was shown, what the customer asked for, and what blocked or nearly blocked the run
* Log every product issue seen on site into the engineering tracker with logs, photos and reproduction steps, so recurring failures reach the product team with evidence
* Support the pre\-sales team with layout inputs, video and photo capture from demos, and the occasional trade show or partner event


**Requirements**
**Essential**
* 1\-3 years of relevant experience in robotics, industrial automation, system integration, field applications, commissioning, or a related technical field
* Hands\-on experience commissioning or deploying mobile robots, AMRs, or similar automation hardware — network setup, mapping, and route/waypoint configuration
* Comfortable troubleshooting live, in unpredictable field conditions (connectivity issues, sensor interference, site\-specific quirks) without escalating every issue
* Strong presentation and communication skills — able to explain technical systems clearly to non\-technical audiences (plant managers, operations heads, safety teams)
* Willingness to travel extensively and work across multiple sites and countries on a recurring basis
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with sales, product, and operations teams, and writing clear, structured technical reports


**Highly desirable**
* Experience with fleet management, asset logistics, or spares/calibration tracking
* Familiarity with syncOS or comparable robot fleet orchestration software
* Prior experience in a pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or field applications engineering role


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment
